scripts.text:
- Wait a moment! -
- Currently you are carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您目前携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库后 -
- 再回来。 -

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
My back is killing me
after stooping over to
pick up stones all day long...
The pain... It's unbearable!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
我弯腰捡了一整天的石头...
腰都快断了...
好痛...简直无法忍受！

scripts.text: Bend with your knees, yo.
scripts.translation: 你该用膝盖弯下去啊。

scripts.text: Gosh, how bad is it?
scripts.translation: 天哪，疼得有多厉害？

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Whippersnapper!
I didn't ask you for
your advice! Don't
patronize an old man!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
臭小鬼！
我没让你给我出主意！
别用那种居高临下的语气
对待一个老人！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Oh, it hurts so much, it's
almost crippling. But I don't
have any choice. I need to
get enough stops to fill
this gap if I want to get
paid. Arrrrgh, damn it!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
哦，疼得厉害，
几乎要瘫了。但我别无选择。
我得捡够足够的石头
来填补这个缺口，才能拿到工钱。
啊...该死！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
If I don't get enough
money to pay for my
granddaughter's medicine,
I won't be able to buy any
medicine for my granddaughter!
And that will be horrible! Ag!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
如果我赚不到足够的钱
给孙女买药，
我就买不起药了！
那可就糟了！啊！

scripts.text: Can I help?
scripts.translation: 我能帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
I appreciate your kindness,
stranger, but no. I have
to do this on my own.
A man must have his pride....
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
我很感激你的好意，
陌生人，但不用了。
我必须靠自己。
男人得有骨气....

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Argh! My back...!
This was totally
unforeseeable!
Please! Please,
for the love of Freya,
please help me!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
啊！我的腰...！
这完全没预料到！
求求你！求求你，
看在芙蕾雅的面子上，
帮帮我吧！

scripts.text: I will help you.
scripts.translation: 我会帮您的。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Thank you!
Thanks so much!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
谢谢！
太感谢了！

scripts.text: What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation: 你想让我做什么？

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Ow-ow-ow! Oh... Okay...
You see those all dark
stones stuck in the ground?
Those are what I need to
pick up. Now don't go
lifting rocks just yet...
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
哎哟哎哟！哦...好吧...
你看到那些嵌在地上的
黑石头了吗？
那些就是我要捡的。先别急着
去搬岩石...

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
I asked some other old
man in town, Absar, to
make me something to help
with my back. He was going
to help me if I gave hi--
ARGH! My back! It hurts!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
我请了镇上另一个老人，
阿布萨尔，帮我做点东西
来缓解腰痛。他答应如果我给他--
啊！我的腰！好痛！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
It hurts so bad! But it's
especially painful right
when I'm about to finish
sentences in which I intend to
tell you important informat--
ARRRGH! Find Absar! Quickly!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
疼死了！但最疼的时候
总是我正要说出
重要信息的时候--
啊啊啊！去找阿布萨尔！快！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Wait, wait...
Maybe I can answer
a few of your questions
before my body is wracked
with throbbing pain. Let's...
Let's at least give it a try.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
等等，等等...
也许我还能回答
你几个问题，
在我全身剧痛之前。让我...
让我至少试试吧。

scripts.text: What's with these stones?
scripts.translation: 这些石头是怎么回事？

scripts.text: Where's the old man?
scripts.translation: 那个老人在哪里？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Well, we use these dark
stones because they're
pretty and easy to process.
They're sort of a specialty
of this town. I get paid to
harvest these handy rocks.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
嗯，我们用这些黑石头
是因为它们漂亮且易于加工。
它们算是这个城镇的特色。
我靠采集这些石头赚钱。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
We can sell these to tourists,
and we even have a factory
that uses these stones.
Still, it's not like the
townspeople are getting
rich off these stones.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
我们可以把它们卖给游客，
甚至有个工厂也用这些石头。
不过，镇上的人
并没有靠这些石头发财。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
All of us are still
barely making a living...
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
我们大家
都还勉强维持生计...

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Absar? He's inside
the Tool Shop. You
can't miss him... Just
look for the man with
the crazy eyes!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
阿布萨尔？他在
工具店里。你肯定找得到...
就找那个眼神疯狂的男人！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Thanks for your help.
If you can't find Absar
in the Tool Shop, then
you might want to stop
by the Tavern. A-auuugh!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
谢谢你的帮忙。
如果在工具店找不到阿布萨尔，
也许可以去酒馆看看。啊...啊...啊！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Thanks for your help.
If you can't find Absar
in the Tool Shop, then
you might want to stop
by the Tavern. A-auuugh!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
谢谢你的帮忙。
如果在工具店找不到阿布萨尔，
也许可以去酒馆看看。啊...啊...啊！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Geez, Absar sure can
be fussy. Still, do your
best to get what he wants.
He won't help me otherwise!
Other than that, he's not
really that bad a guy...
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
天哪，阿布萨尔还真是挑剔。
不过，还是尽量满足他的要求吧。
不然他就不肯帮我了！
除此之外，他其实也不是什么坏人...

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Oh good, you're back!
Did you bring what
Absar made for me?
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
哦，你回来了！
你带阿布萨尔给我做的东西了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, here...
scripts.translation: 是的，给你...

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
So this is what he
was talking about?
How does it... Ah!
Here we go! If I pull
the handle, that end of
the stick will pick stuff up!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
原来这就是他说的东西？
该怎么用呢...啊！
我懂了！拉动这个手柄，
那根棍子的末端就能把东西捡起来！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
This is great! I won't
have to bend over to pick
up stones anymore! Heh,
he must be awfully proud
of this useful invention~
I can imagine him strutting.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
太棒了！我再也不用弯腰捡石头了！
呵呵，他一定对这个实用的发明很自豪吧~
我都能想象到他得意洋洋的样子。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Um, did he have anything
to say after he gave this
to you? I'm just curious.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
那个，他给你这个的时候，
有没有说什么话？我只是有点好奇。

scripts.text: This message...
scripts.translation: 这封信...

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Oh... I thought he
would forget all about
that. Well, it's a relief
to know that now. That's
really very nice of him.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
哦...我还以为他全忘了呢。
现在知道了，真是让人放心。
他真的很贴心。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
I hate to ask you...
But would you mind
helping me out one
more time?
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
真不好意思要麻烦你...
但你能不能再帮我一次？

scripts.text: Huh? What is it?
scripts.translation: 嗯？怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Don't worry, it's not
too hard. Would you just
deliver the stones I gathered
to the factory in town? It's
near the airport or airship or
something. It won't take long.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
别担心，不难。
你能把我采集的石头送到镇上的工厂吗？
就在机场或飞空艇附近。不会花太久的。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Thanks again for your help!
What did Absar call this
thing again? A Tactile...
Extendable... Damn it...
Why's the name so long?
Anyway, it's usefull~
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
再次感谢你的帮忙！
阿布萨尔刚才管这个叫什么来着？触觉...
延伸器...该死...
为什么名字这么长？
总之，它很有用~

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Oh, you're back!
I really appreciate all
of your help. I don't have
much, and I know you weren't
expecting a reward, but I'd
like to give you something.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
哦，你回来了！
非常感谢你的帮助。我没什么钱，
我知道你也没指望什么报酬，
但我还是想送你点东西。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Ah, here we are. I found
these while harvesting stones
I was told that adventurers
find these useful. Anyway,
I hope you like these rocks...
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
啊，找到了。这是我采石头时捡到的。
听说冒险者觉得这些很有用。总之，
希望你喜欢这些石头...

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Thanks to you and Absar,
my poor back hasn't been
bothering me at all lately.
I should be taking better
care of myself at my age...
scripts.translation:
[扎巴鲁]
多亏了你和阿布萨尔，
我最近腰都不疼了。
像我这个年纪，本该更注意保养身体的...

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Bwahahaha!
Once... Once this is completed, I'll...
Mwahahahahahahahah!
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
哇哈哈哈！
只要...只要完成这个，我就...
哇哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
I'm so close to
completion. Now, if
I just turn this here...
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
马上就要完成了。现在，
只要转动这里...

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打扰一下...

scripts.text:
[Absar]
What?! Who dares
disturb me?! N-no!
Look! Look what you did!
You made me screw up!
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
什么？！谁敢打扰我？！不...不！
看！看看你干了什么！
你让我搞砸了！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Oh, no...
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Absar]
How...?!
No! I failed again!
D-DAAAAAAAAAAAMN IIIII--
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
怎...怎么会？！
不！我又失败了！
该...该死啊——

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Huh? What are you...
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
嗯？你是...？
你想干什么？

scripts.text: Oh, I-I'm...

[Absar]
Spit it out. Tell me
what you want, not your
name. Hurry, can't you
see that I'm busy?
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
有话快说。告诉我
你想要什么，别报名字。
快点，没看到我正忙着吗？

scripts.text: I... I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 我...我很抱歉。

scripts.text: I'm here for Mr. Zabaroo...
scripts.translation: 我是来找扎巴鲁先生的...

scripts.text:
[Absar]
If only you didn't
interrupt me! Then
I'd already have...
Ugh! Back to work!
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
要不是你打断我！
我早就...唉！继续干活！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Zabaroo? What does...
Oh. Never mind. I think
I remember what he asked
me to make him. So did
you bring all the materials?
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
扎巴鲁？他让我做什...
哦。算了。我想起来了，
他让我给他做的那个东西。那么，
你把材料都带齐了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: What materials...?
scripts.translation: 什么材料...？

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Great, we can get
started and m--
Liar. You don't even know
what you're supposed to
bring me, do you?!
Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
很好，我们可以开始做...等等——
骗子。你根本不知道
该给我带什么，对吧？！
滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Of course. I didn't tell him
what materials I needed
anyway. Heh heh! Now, this
is what I need you to bring.
Listen up, okay? And hurry.
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
当然。反正我也没告诉他
我需要什么材料。嘿嘿！好了，
这就是你需要带回来的东西。
听好了，好吗？快点。

scripts.text:
[Absar]
^4D4DFF5 Maneater Roots^000000,
^4D4DFF2 Glacial Hearts^000000, and
^4D4DFF5 Steel^000000. If you don't
come back soon, then
I won't help you. I've got
projects I'm working on!
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
^4D4DFF5噬人树根^000000、
^4D4DFF2冰块心脏^000000，还有
^4D4DFF5钢铁^000000。如果你不快点回来，
我就不帮你了。我手头
还有项目要做呢！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Good, you finally
brought everthing.
I was just about to
give up on you, so
consider yourself lucky!
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
很好，你终于
把东西都带来了。
我差点就要放弃你了，
算你运气好！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Give me a second.
You won't have to
wait long to see
my great invention!
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
给我一点时间。
你不用等太久，
就能看到我的伟大发明了！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
What the hell?
Hurry and bring
^4D4DFF5 Maneater Roots^000000,
^4D4DFF2 Glacial Hearts^000000, and
^4D4DFF5 Steel^000000! Do you think
I'm doing this for fun?!
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
该死？
快点把^4D4DFF5噬人树根^000000、
^4D4DFF2冰块心脏^000000，还有
^4D4DFF5钢铁^000000带回来！你以为
我是在开玩笑吗？！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Here you are...
Well, I don't know
if you appreciate
inventions, but this
is a Tactile Extendable
Clamp-Release Mechanism!
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
给你...嗯，我不知道
你能不能欣赏发明，但这是
一种触觉可伸缩夹持释放装置！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tack... What...?

[Absar]
...............................
You can use this to pick
things up. From a distance.

[Absar]
Anyway, when you get back
to Zabaroo, let me him know
that he doesn't owe me
anything anymore. He'll...
He'll know what I mean...
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
总之，等你回到扎巴鲁那里，
告诉他他不再欠我任何东西了。他会...
他会明白我的意思...

scripts.text:
[Absar]
It's a ''Tactile Extendable
Clamp-Release Mechanism.''
What's so hard to understand
about that? Hmpf! I know!
It must be the educational
system! They're to blame!
scripts.translation:
[阿布萨尔]
是“触觉可伸缩夹持释放装置”。
这有什么难懂的吗？哼！我知道了！
肯定是教育制度的问题！都是他们的错！

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Hey, employees only beyond this point!
Geez, don't we have a sigh that says that?
We should get one...
Anyway, get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[米尔亨]
嘿，仅限员工进入！
天哪，我们难道没有挂个牌子写着这个吗？
我们应该弄一个...
总之，请出去。

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Hey, employees only
beyond this point!
Geez, don't we have
a sign that says that?
We should get one...
Anyway, get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[米尔亨]
嘿，仅限员工进入！
天哪，我们难道没有挂个牌子写着这个吗？
我们应该弄一个...
总之，请出去。

scripts.text: I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 对不起。

scripts.text: I've brought these...
scripts.translation: 我带来了这些...

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
You're sorry,
I get it. Ummm...
Aren't you leaving?
scripts.translation:
[米尔亨]
你道歉了，我收到了。嗯...
你还不走吗？

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Huh? What's this name
tag? Zabaroo? Wait a sec...
You're definitely not him!
scripts.translation:
[米尔亨]
咦？这是什么名牌？扎巴鲁？等一下...
你肯定不是他！

scripts.text: I'm here on his behalf.
scripts.translation: 我是替他来的。

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Ah, I get it. Zabaroo's
back has really been
bothering him lately.
Okay, we can bend the
rules a bit in this situation.
scripts.translation:
[米尔亨]
啊，我明白了。扎巴鲁最近
腰一直不舒服。
好吧，在这种情况下，我们可以
稍微通融一下。

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Bring those rocks over
to Bahed over there.
He'll take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[米尔亨]
把那些岩石带到那边的巴赫德那里。
他会处理它们的。

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Hetarium ...
What's so special about
it? I mean, it looks just like
Iron Ore. Why the hell is
it like classified info?
scripts.translation:
[米尔亨]
赫塔里姆...
它有什么特别的？我是说，它看起来
就像铁矿石。为什么它像机密情报一样？

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
I wish I could return to
Rekenber Headquarters...
I hate being stuck here
gathering silly rocks in
the middle of nowhere.
scripts.translation:
[米尔亨]
我真希望能回到雷肯贝尔总部...
我讨厌被困在这里，
在荒郊野外收集愚蠢的岩石。

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
lately, I've been feeling so weak...
I heard the guy before me had to quit because he also started feeling weak.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
最近，我感觉自己很虚弱...
我听说我之前的那个家伙
因为也开始感觉虚弱而辞职了。

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
It couldn't be...
It couldn't be because of this 'Hetarium'...
That's just plain crazy...
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
不会吧...
不会是因为这个“赫塔里姆”吧...
那太疯狂了...

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Oh, you got the rocks?
You brought them for Zabaroo?
Oh, how is he doing? I hear
he threw out his back.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
哦，你拿到岩石了？
你是替扎巴鲁带来的？
哦，他怎么样了？听说他
闪到腰了。

scripts.text: He still hurts.
scripts.translation: 他还是很疼。

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Oh no... I'm so sorry
to hear that. I hope he
feels better soon. Anyway,
why don't you bring the
rocks over here?
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
天哪...听到这个我很抱歉。
希望他早日康复。总之，
你为什么不把岩石
带到这里来呢？

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Let me confirm Zabaroo's
quota for today. Ah, and
don't worry, we pay him
for his quotas regularly.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
让我确认一下扎巴鲁
今天的配额。啊，还有，
别担心，我们会定期
支付他的配额费用。

scripts.text: I have a question...
scripts.translation: 我有一个问题...

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Hm? What'd you want
to know? I can't say that
I know everything, but
I'll try my best to tell you
what I know. I mean,
you helped Zabaroo, so...
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
嗯？你想问什么？我不能说
我什么都知道，但我会尽力
告诉你我所知道的。我是说，
你帮了扎巴鲁，所以...

scripts.text: What's this Hetarium??
scripts.translation: 这个赫塔里姆是什么？

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Well, it hasn't been that
long since these rocks
attracted attention outside
of town. Before all this,
the townspeople just
made carvings out of them.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
这些岩石引起镇外关注的时间并不长。在此之前，镇民们只是用它们雕刻一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Then, all of a sudden,
these people from--I guess
it was Schwarzwald--came
and bought a lot of these
stones. Later, they even built
this factory to process them!
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
然后，突然之间，那些来自——我想是修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德——的人来了，买走了很多这种石头。后来，他们甚至在这里建了这家工厂来处理它们！

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Oh, they tried using machines
to harvest these stones, but
they all broke down too soon.
That's why they hired people
in Veins to collect them.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
哦，他们曾试图用机器开采这些石头，但机器很快就全都坏了。所以他们雇了伯仁斯的人来收集它们。

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
I'm not sure many people
know who owns this factory.
Maybe it's Rekenber? Yes,
I saw one of their corporate
airships come to town, so
I think it might be them.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
我不太确定很多人知道这家工厂是谁的。也许是雷肯贝尔？是的，我看到过他们的公司飞空艇来到镇上，所以我觉得可能是他们。

scripts.text: How do they use Hetarium??
scripts.translation: 他们如何使用赫塔里姆？

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
I'm not really sure. I just
happened to overhear some
of the higher ups mention
something about hearts?
Pieces of hearts? Doesn't
make any sense to me.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
我不太清楚。我只是偶然听到一些高层提到什么“心脏”？“心脏碎片”？对我来说毫无意义。

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
All I gathered was that
they were using the stones
to build a machine related
to those hearts. That's
all I know. Anyway, please
leave the stones over there~
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
我只知道他们正在用这些石头建造一台与那些心脏有关的机器。我就知道这么多。总之，请把那边的石头放下~

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Everyday I feel
weaker and weaker...
Could this be chronic
fatigue syndrome? Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
每天我都觉得越来越虚弱...
这是慢性疲劳综合征吗？唉...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
What the heck are these rocks?
They're ordinary stones, aren't they?
They don't pay me enough here...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
这些岩石到底是什么鬼？
它们不就是普通的石头吗？
这里的工资也太低了...

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Where the heck
is it? I don't... Where...?
He's got to be around here
somewhere, I think...
scripts.translation:
[鲁尼]
该死，他在哪？我不...在哪...？
他应该就在这附近吧...

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Oh, it's just...
Some guy sent me on a
delivery errand, but I can't
find the recipient. He said
that I can't miss him, but
I still can't figure it out.
scripts.translation:
[鲁尼]
哦，原来是...
有个家伙让我送个快递，但我找不到收件人。他说我肯定能找到的，但我还是搞不清楚。

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
I should have asked for
the exact location. I mean,
if I don't find him, then I'll
never get paid for doing
this delivery. ^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[鲁尼]
我本该问清楚具体位置的。我是说，如果我找不到他，我就永远拿不到这次送货的报酬了。^333333*叹气*^000000

scripts.text: Sounds tough. Good luck!
scripts.translation: 听起来很难。祝你好运！

scripts.text: Do you need any help?
scripts.translation: 需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Thanks. I think
I just might need it.
Where could this guy
be? If he's expecting
a delivery, he should
make himself easy to find...
scripts.translation:
[鲁尼]
谢谢。我想我确实需要它。
这家伙会在哪？如果他等着收货，应该让自己容易找到才对...

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Yeah, sure, it'd be great
if you could help me. Let's
see, I need to deliver this
letter to a bard named...
It was... Ah, ^FF0000Lasda Midar^000000!
scripts.translation:
[鲁尼]
是啊，如果你能帮我那就太好了。让我看看，我需要把这封信送给一位名叫...
是...啊，^FF0000拉斯达·米达尔^000000！

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
I've looked everywhere
in town for someone that
looks like a Bard, but I'm
not having any luck. If you
find him, would you tell me?
scripts.translation:
[鲁尼]
我在镇上到处找看起来像诗人的人，但一直没找到。如果你找到他，能告诉我吗？

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
I still haven't
found Lasda Midar.
Would you let me know
if you find him so that
I can deliver his letter?
scripts.translation:
[鲁尼]
我还没找到拉斯达·米达尔。
如果你找到他，能告诉我吗？这样我就可以给他送信了。

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Lasda Midar...
Where the heck
could that guy be?
scripts.translation:
[鲁尼]
拉斯达·米达尔...
这家伙到底在哪？

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Wow, did you really
find Lasda Midar?
Why couldn't I find him?
Anyway, thank you so much
for your help. I thought I was
going to fail my delivery!
scripts.translation:
[鲁尼]
哇，你真的找到拉斯达·米达尔了？
为什么我找不到他？不管怎样，非常感谢你的帮助。我以为我要送不到货了！

scripts.text: He asked me to give you this.
scripts.translation: 他让我把这个给你。

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Hey, alright! Thanks
for the cash! Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[鲁尼]
嘿，太好了！
谢谢你的钱！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Nice day out, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[鲁尼]
今天天气真好，不是吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Hello there, isn't today
such a wonderful day?
Nice weather always
inspires the poet in me,
and I can't seem to stop
singing my heart out~
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
你好呀，今天真是美好的一天呢！
好天气总能激发我的诗兴，
我忍不住想尽情歌唱~

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Why, what a glorious
day! I should sing a song
in praise of its wonder!
Ooooh... La la la-la~
Girls, girls, giiiirls...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
哇，多么辉煌的一天！
我应该唱首歌来赞美它的奇妙！
噢...啦啦啦啦~
女孩，女孩，女...女孩...

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打扰一下...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Why, what a glorious
day! I should sing a song
in praise of its wonder!
Ooooh... La la la-la~
Girls, girls, giiiirls...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
哇，多么辉煌的一天！
我应该唱首歌来赞美它的奇妙！
噢...啦啦啦啦~
女孩，女孩，女...女孩...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Girls, girls, giiiirls...
Making my heart
beat like... Like it's
going too fast. My heart's
racing... And you're at the
finish line--Love Champion!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
女孩，女孩，女...女孩...
让我的心跳得...像是要失控了。
我的心在狂跳...而你就在终点线——
爱情冠军！

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Oh? Don't stare at me
like that, you're making
me blush. Did you need to
talk to me or something?.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
噢？别那样盯着我看，
我会害羞的。你是有事要找我吗？

scripts.text: I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 对不起。

scripts.text: Are you ^ff0000Lasda Midar^000000?
scripts.translation: 你是^ff0000拉斯达·米达尔^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Oh, that's alright.
...............................
Girl, I'll laugh at all your
jokes, and agree with yourv
politics~ You're hot! But
baby, you're dumb as bricks~
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
噢，没关系。
...............................
女孩，我会嘲笑你所有的笑话，
并同意你的政治观点~
你很火辣！但是宝贝，你笨得像块砖头~

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Oh? Oh, yes, that's me.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
噢？噢，是的，那就是我。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I'm here to deliver this to you.
scripts.translation: 我来给你送这个。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Ah! He must have finally
sent it. Would you please
give me a second? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
啊！他终于寄来了。
请给我一点时间好吗？让我看看...

scripts.text:
^3355FFLasda opened the letter
and started reading it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF拉斯达拆开信件，开始阅读。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Umm...
Oh, no...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
嗯...
噢，不...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Ah, I'm sorry for
making you wait.
Here, please give
this money to that
kid that was supposed
to come find me here.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
啊，抱歉让你久等了。
请把这些钱给那个本该来这里找我的小孩。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I'd like you to come
talk to me again later
if you have the time
See you around~
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
如果你有时间，
稍后再来找我聊聊吧。
回头见~

scripts.text:
^3355FFLasda seems to be
lost in deep thought.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF拉斯达似乎陷入了沉思。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Oh good, you came back!
Thanks for delivering that
letter for me. Listen, you
mind listening to me for
a bit? I want to ask you
for your help with something.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
噢，你回来了！
谢谢你帮我送那封信。
听着，你介意听我说几句吗？
我想请你帮个忙。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
You see, the letter you
brought me was from my old
best friend. I haven't heard
from him for a while, so
I was pretty worried...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
你看，你带给我的那封信
是我最好的老朋友寄来的。
我已经很久没收到他的消息了，
所以我很担心...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Vitre said in his letter
that he's in jail under
false charges so he wants
me to help him out. However,
there isn't much I can do.
Do you think you can help him?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
维特雷在信里说，
他因冤屈被关在监狱里，
希望我能帮他。但是，
我无能为力。
你觉得你能帮他吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Thank you so much!
I guess the best thing
to do for now is to find
my friend in a prison in
^FF0000Morocc^000000, and see what
you can do to help him..
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
非常感谢！
我想现在最好的办法是
去^FF0000莫洛奇^000000的监狱找到我的朋友，
看看你能怎么帮他。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I... I guess...
You must not be
able to help him too...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
我...我想...
你大概也帮不了他吧...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I suppose that you
must already be busy
doing something else.
Well, I understand...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
我想你肯定正忙着做别的事情。
嗯，我理解...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I still can't believe
Vitre is being held
in prison in Morocc. I mean,
what could have happened?
I hope you can help him...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
我还是无法相信维特雷会被关在莫洛奇的监狱里。我是说，
到底发生了什么？
希望你能帮到他...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
He was arrested because
he's suspected of espionage?
That doesn't make any sense.
What could be going on?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
他是因为被怀疑从事间谍活动而被逮捕的吗？
这完全说不通。
到底是怎么回事？

scripts.text: ^ff0000Krieg^000000 told me that.
scripts.translation: ^ff0000克里格^000000告诉我的。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Krieg? Do you mean Krieg
Laje Mandi? I know him quite
well, actually. Let me write
you a letter or recommendation.
Hopefully, it'll be enough to
let you enter the prison.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
克里格？你是说克里格·拉杰·曼迪吗？
其实我跟他很熟。让我给你写一封介绍信吧。
希望这封信能让你进入监狱。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Hurry and go bring
my letter to Krieg.
I wonder what happened...
There must be some kind
of weird misunderstanding.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
快去把我的信交给克里格。
我想知道到底发生了什么...
肯定有什么奇怪的误会。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
He really asked you
to break him out of jail?
Well, I know that's a morally
hazy area, but I hope that
you do your best to help Vitre.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
他真的让你去把他从监狱里救出来？
嗯，我知道这在道德上有点模糊，但我希望你能尽力帮助维特雷。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Thanks for offering
to help me out. I still
can't believe Vitre had
the gall to just break
out of prison, though...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
谢谢你愿意帮我。不过，我还是无法相信维特雷竟然敢直接从监狱里逃出来...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I still can't do
anything to help him,
so please do what you
can to take care of him
for me. I really appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
我仍然无法为他做任何事，
所以请尽力照顾他。
非常感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Ah, you're back. I'm sure
you have a lot to ask me
right now. You deserve to
know that everything I asked
you to do was part of a plan
to confirm Vitre's guilt.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
啊，你回来了。我想你现在有很多问题要问我。
你有权利知道，我让你做的这一切，
都是为了确认维特雷有罪而制定的计划的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
We arrested him once
we learned that he was
an Arunafeltz spy, but we
couldn't punish him since
we lacked concrete proof.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
当我们得知他是阿鲁纳菲兹的间谍后，
我们就逮捕了他，但由于缺乏确凿的证据，
我们无法惩罚他。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
That's why we allowed
him to escape: we planned
on following him to get the
proof that we needed. Our
sting was even able to round
up all of his compatriots!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
所以我们允许他逃跑：我们计划跟踪他，
以获取我们需要的证据。我们的<黑暗搜集者>奖励甚至能抓获他的所有同伙！

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I'm sorry for keeping
you in the dark, but it was
essential to the plan. We
couldn't have done it without
your help. Please take this
reward with our sincere thanks.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
抱歉瞒着你，但这对于计划至关重要。
没有你的帮助，我们无法做到这一点。请收下这份奖励，以表达我们诚挚的谢意。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
We're having too many
cases involving spies
like Vitre lately. This
might be a sign that
Arunafeltz is planning
to move against us...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯达]
最近涉及像维特雷这样的间谍的案件太多了。
这可能意味着阿鲁纳菲兹正在策划对我们采取行动...

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Only authorized
personnel can enter
this prison. You need
a permit if you want
to be able to enter.
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
只有授权人员才能进入这座监狱。
如果你想进入，需要许可证。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
What? You want to meet
the prisoner? I'm sorry,
but he's not allowed to
see anyone since he was
arrested on suspicion
of espionage.
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
什么？你想见那个囚犯？
抱歉，由于他被怀疑从事间谍活动而被逮捕，
他目前不允许会见任何人。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Huh. You're awfully
persistent. Alright,
if you can do me a favor,
I'll let you in. Bring me
1 dish of ^FF0000Fried Monkey Tails^000000
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
嗯。你还真执着。好吧，
如果你能帮我一个忙，我就让你进去。给我带一份^FF0000热炒猴尾巴^000000

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Of course, I can only let
you inside. Whether they'll
actually let you meet the
prisoner is another matter.
So do we have a deal?
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
当然，我只能让你进去。他们是否真的让你见那个囚犯，
那是另一回事。那我们成交吗？

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Ah, that's the stuff!
Thanks for the Fried
Monkey Tails~ Alright,
go talk to ^FF0000Sir Krieg^000000 in
Morocc Castle. Get his
approval, and I'll let you in.
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
啊，就是这个味道！
谢谢你的热炒猴尾巴~ 好了，
去莫洛奇城堡找^FF0000克里格大人^000000。
获得他的批准，我就让你进去。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Bring me a plate of
^FF0000Fried Monkey Tails^000000.
Do it, or I won't help
you out. I mean, I know
you mean well, but I'm
risking my job here...
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
给我带一份^FF0000热炒猴尾巴^000000。
快点，不然我可帮不了你。
我知道你是好意，但我在这里可是冒着丢掉饭碗的风险...

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
You didn't get approval
from Sir Krieg yet? You'd
better do it, or there's no
point in entering this prison.
You can't just sneak around
inside this place, you know?
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
你还没拿到克里格大人的批准？
你最好去办，否则进这座监狱也没意义。
你知道的，不能随便在这地方乱晃。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Did you really get
Sir Krieg's approval?
Alright, you may enter now.
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
你真的拿到了克里格大人的批准？
好吧，现在你可以进去了。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Do you want to enter?
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
你要进去吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Be careful when you talk
to that guy: he's a smooth
talker, and almost charmed
a lot of the guards into
letting him go free.
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
跟那个人说话时要小心：
他是个能言善辩的家伙，
差点把很多卫兵都忽悠得放他走了。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Take your time.
If you're not mentally
prepared, then it's not
a good idea to talk
to the prisoner.
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
慢慢来。
如果你还没做好心理准备，
那最好不要去见那个囚犯。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Argh, I'm in trouble.
The prisoner escaped.
How could I let this...
happen?! Damn, I need to
report this to Mr. Krieg
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
啊，糟了。
囚犯逃跑了。
我怎么会让他...
跑掉？！该死，我得去报告克里格先生。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
What a relief! They
really set it up so that
the prisoner could escape?
Well, I thought I was going
to get fired for all that.
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
真是虚惊一场！
他们居然真的设局让囚犯逃跑？
还好，我还以为自己要被开除了。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
I'm in charge of public
security here in Morocc.
Lately, there have been
more incidents disturbing
the public peace and
many unsettling rumors...
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
我负责莫洛奇的公共安全。
最近，扰乱公共秩序的事件越来越多，
还有许多令人不安的传闻...

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
Hello, adventurer.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
你好，冒险者。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I'd like to see a prisoner, Mr. Vitre.
scripts.translation: 我想见见囚犯，维特雷先生。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
Vitre? I'm sorry, but
I can't approve of that.
I'd allow visitors for normal
prisoners, but not for people
suspected of espionage.
That's why he's in jail.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
维特雷？抱歉，
我不能批准。
普通囚犯我可以允许探视，
但被怀疑从事间谍活动的人不行。
这就是他被关押的原因。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
If I knew you personally,
or if someone I trust can
vouch for you, then I'd
reconsider letting you
meet Vitre. Otherwise,
I just can't do it.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
如果我和你是旧识，
或者有我信任的人为你作保，
我会重新考虑让你见维特雷。
否则，我实在无法答应。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
I can't let you meet
Vitre until I'm absolutely
sure that you're not involved
with any espionage activities.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
在我完全确定你没有参与任何间谍活动之前，
我不能让你见维特雷。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
I can't let you meet
Vitre until I'm absolutely
sure that you're not involved
with any espionage activities.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
在我完全确定你没有参与任何间谍活动之前，
我不能让你见维特雷。

scripts.text: Here's a letter from Lasda.
scripts.translation: 这是拉斯达的信件。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
Lasda? Now there's a
man I hold in high regard.
Please let me read what
he has to say. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
拉斯达？那可是我十分敬重的人。
请让我看看他写了什么。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
Alright, I'll let you visit
Vitre. I'll send a message
to the prison ward so that
he'll let you talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
好吧，我允许你探视维特雷。
我会通知监狱看守，让他允许你与他交谈。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
Hmm... This is almost too
difficult for me to handle.
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
嗯...这对我来说几乎太难处理了。
我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
I understand that you were
instrumental in solving a
problem regarding public
safety. I'd just like to thank
you, and apologize for any
trouble I might have caused.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
我了解到你在解决公共安全问题上发挥了重要作用。
我想向你表示感谢，并为可能给你带来的麻烦道歉。

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打扰一下...

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Hm? I'm Vitre Bizlita.
As you can see, I'm not in
any real position to help
you. Still, did you want
to ask me something?
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
嗯？我是维特雷·比兹利塔。
你也看出来了，我现在这处境
根本帮不上什么忙。
不过，你有什么想问我的吗？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: I'm here on behalf of Mr. Lasda.
scripts.translation: 我是代表拉斯达先生来的。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Well...
It's nice to
receive visitors.
Jail can be lonely....
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
嗯...
能有人来探望，
感觉还不错。
监狱里挺孤独的....

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Oh, good. Lasda finally
got my letter, eh? I don't
know what the hell's going
on. I mean, all I remember
is that these strange men
came and brought me here.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
哦，太好了。拉斯达终于
收到我的信了，是吗？
我不知道到底发生了什么事。
我只记得那些奇怪的男人
把我带到了这里。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
I... I don't think
they'll let me out
of here. I mean, they
jailed me and there's no
proof I did anything wrong.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
我...我觉得他们
不会让我出去的。
毕竟他们把我关了起来，
而且没有任何证据
证明我做了什么坏事。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
My life is in danger as
long as I'm here, so I have
to get out as soon as I can.
Luckily, I figured out that
I can open these doors if
I just had 2 things.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
只要我还在这里，
我的生命就处于危险之中，
所以我必须尽快逃出去。
幸运的是，我发现只要
有两样东西，我就能打开这些门。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
I just need a ^FF0000Megaphone^000000
and a ^FF0000Violin^000000. Luckily, they're
pretty mundane objects, so no
one would suspect anything if
you brought them here. Um...
You will help me, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
我只需要一个^FF0000扩音器^000000
和一把^FF0000小提琴^000000。幸运的是，它们
都是很普通的物品，所以即使
你带它们来这里，也不会有人
起疑。那个...
你会帮我的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
I understand if you have any
doubts about my innocence.
But think about it: wouldn't
you want to see what I do
with a Megaphone and Violin?
Sounds pretty cool, huh?
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
如果你对我的清白有任何
怀疑，我都能理解。
但请想想看：你难道不
想看看我用扩音器和小提琴
能做出什么吗？
听起来很酷，不是吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can hear someone
mumbling from the cell
next to Vitre's.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你听到维特雷隔壁的牢房里
有人在喃喃自语。^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
I wonder how the lady
in the Dancer Job Change
place is doing by now...
scripts.translation:
[???]
不知道那位在舞娘转职处
的女士现在怎么样了...

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Didn't you bring the
Megaphone and Violin?
The longer I sit here,
the more likely it is
that they'll kill me!
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
你没带扩音器和小提琴吗？
我在这里坐得越久，
他们杀我的可能性就越大！

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
You brought me a
Megaphone and Violin?
Perfect! Now, step aside
Can't have you getting hurt.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
你带了扩音器和小提琴给我？
完美！现在，站到一边去。
我可不想让你受伤。

scripts.text:
^3355FFVitre drew in a deep
breath, and then smashed
the steel bars of his cell
with the Violin. Surprisingly,
the door swings open with
a very loud noise.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF维特雷深吸了一口气，
然后用小提琴砸向牢房的钢条。
出人意料的是，门伴随着
巨大的声响打开了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Heh! That was a little
harder than I thought,
but it looks like I'm free~
Alright, let's get a move on.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
嘿！这比我想象的
要难一点，但看起来我自由了~
好了，我们赶紧走吧。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
What?! What's this noise?!
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
什么？！这是什么声音？！

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Hey! How did you
get out of your cell?!
Get back in there, NOW!
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
嘿！你是怎么从牢房里
出来的？！
立刻回去，马上！

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
If you were me, would
you go back in your cell
just because someone's
yelling at you? Forget it~
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
如果我是你，我会因为
有人冲我大喊大叫就
回到牢房里吗？
别做梦了~

scripts.text:
^3355FFVitre raised the Megaphone
to his mouth, and drew in
another deep breath.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF维特雷把扩音器举到嘴边，
又深吸了一口气。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Wah!
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
哇！

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Arg...
Oh Lord...!
M-my ears...
scripts.translation:
[杰西]
啊...
天哪...！
我...我的耳朵...

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Heh! I love it when
a plan comes together~
Let's get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
嘿！计划顺利实施的感觉真棒~
我们快离开这里吧！

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Didn't you bring
a Megaphone and
a Violin? Please
hurry, I don't have
much time left!
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
你不是带了
扩音器和
小提琴吗？
请快点，
我没多少时间了！

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Heh! I love it when
a plan comes together~
Let's get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
嘿！计划顺利实施的感觉真棒~
我们快离开这里吧！

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
This stinks. Why am
I locked up in here?
I didn't do anything
to deserve this!
scripts.translation:
[阮]
真够恶心的。我为什么
会被关在这里？
我什么都没做，
不配受这种待遇！

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
It's getting to be so
bad that I even miss the
sound of Hianna's voice.
It's freakishly loud.
You couldn't outyell her
even with a Megaphone.
scripts.translation:
[阮]
情况糟到
我甚至开始想念
希安娜的声音了。
那声音吵得吓人。
就算用扩音器
也吵不过她。

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
This stinks. Why am
I locked up in here?
I didn't do anything
to deserve this!
scripts.translation:
[阮]
真够恶心的。我为什么
会被关在这里？
我什么都没做，
不配受这种待遇！

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
It's getting to be so
bad that I even miss the
sound of Hianna's voice.
It's freakishly loud.
You couldn't outyell her
even with a Megaphone.
scripts.translation:
[阮]
情况糟到
我甚至开始想念
希安娜的声音了。
那声音吵得吓人。
就算用扩音器
也吵不过她。

scripts.text: Where I can find that Megaphone?
scripts.translation: 我在哪里能找到那个扩音器？

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
Huh? Why would you
want to know that?
scripts.translation:
[阮]
哈？你为什么
想知道那个？

scripts.text: I really need one!
scripts.translation: 我真的很需要！

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
Uh, you can get one from
that Dancer Job Change
place in Comodo. They're
really hard to get, though,
if not impossible. Knock
yourself out, buddy.
scripts.translation:
[阮]
呃，你可以去
克魔岛那个舞娘
转职的地方买。
不过很难买到，
甚至可能买不到。
祝你好运，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
Nobody knows what
will happen tomorrow.
I mean, this is a world of
miracles and tragedies.
Death, or real love...
You will never know what will happen.
scripts.translation:
[阮]
没人知道
明天会发生什么。
我是说，这是一个
充满奇迹和悲剧的世界。
死亡，或者真爱...
你永远不知道会发生什么。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Keep up the good work,
everyone! There's only
a few days left until the
big performance! Hey...
You! Can't you do it right?
Turn your waist quicker!
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
大家继续加油！
距离大型演出
只剩几天了！
嘿...
你！能不能做对？
腰转得再快一点！

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Hey, who are you?
We already have enough
problems with too many
pervs ogling the Dancers.
I'd prefer it if you didn't
come to watch us practice.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
嘿，你是谁？
我们已经够头疼了，
总是有那么多变态
盯着舞娘看。
我建议你
别来围观我们排练。

scripts.text: I want a Megaphone.
scripts.translation: 我想要一个扩音器。

scripts.text: Eeek...
scripts.translation: 哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
If you really want to
watch us dance, come to
the show and buy a ticket.
Watching for free isn't
exactly supporting the arts.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
如果你真的想看我们跳舞，
就来演出时买票吧。
免费观看
算不上支持艺术。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
You want a Megaphone?
Well, I'm sorry, but it's
not just something I can
lend to anybody. Then again
it's not like you can find one
anywhere else, either.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
你想要扩音器？
嗯，很抱歉，
它不是随便就能借给别人的。
不过话说回来，
你在别处也找不到。

scripts.text: Please! I'll do anything!
scripts.translation: 求你了！我什么都愿意做！

scripts.text: Later.
scripts.translation: 以后再说。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Alright, then.
I'm sorry that
I can't help you.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
好吧。
很抱歉，
我帮不了你。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Anything, huh?
Well, you just said
the magic word. Listen
carefully to what I want
you to do for me.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
什么都愿意做？
嗯，你可是说对了
关键的词。仔细听
听我要你为我做什么。

scripts.text: Listen
scripts.translation: 听

scripts.text: Reconsider
scripts.translation: 再考虑一下

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
First, I want a little
cash. Consider it a rental
fee. 500,000 zeny should be
just about enough. Then,
I want you to do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
首先，我需要一点
现金。把它当作
租赁费吧。500,000 Zeny
应该差不多够了。然后，
我要你帮我一个忙。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
The Schwarzwald Republic
requested me to send some
Dancers for some party, but
I don't have enough guards
to protect them on their
way over there.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国
要求我派一些舞娘
去参加他们的派对，
但我没有足够的卫兵
来保护她们
前往那里的路途。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
If you act as bodyguard
to my Dancers on the way
to the Schwarzwald Republic,
I'll lend you my Megaphone
once you come back. So...
How does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
如果你能担任我的舞娘
前往修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国
路上的保镖，
等你回来我就把扩音器
借给你。那么...
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Sounds good.
scripts.translation: 听起来不错。

scripts.text: Like a ripoff.
scripts.translation: 简直是在抢钱。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
I'm glad you agree~
Okay, the Dancers are
waiting are the entrance,
so bring them over to the
Schwarzwald Republic as
soon as you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
很高兴你同意了~
好的，舞娘们
正在入口处等着，
所以等你准备好了，
就把她们带到
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国吧。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
So... I guess you
didn't need that
Megaphone as
badly as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
那么...看来你
并没有我想象中
那么急需那个
扩音器呢。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Alright, take your
time. I'm in no rush.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
好的，慢慢来。
我不着急。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
What are you still doing
here? Shouldn't you be
escorting the Dancers to
the Schwaltvalt Republic
already? Get a move on~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
你还在这里做什么？
难道你不应该
护送舞娘们去
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国吗？
快点行动吧~

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Thanks for all your
hard work. The Dancers
told me that you did a good
job escorting them. Now...
Do you have the money?
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
谢谢你的辛苦工作。
舞娘们告诉我
你护送她们做得很好。那么...
你有带钱吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
What's this? Hmm...
I think you made a mistake.
This isn't enough money.
Remember, 500,000 zeny~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
这是什么？嗯...
我想你算错了。
钱不够。
记住，是500,000 Zeny~

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Perfect. Well, here's
your Megaphone. Thanks
for everything, and I'll see
you around, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
完美。那么，
这是你的扩音器。
谢谢你的帮助，
再见了，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
I can't have you breaking
your promises, so I won't
give you the Megaphone
until you pay me the
500,000 zeny that you
said that you would.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
我不能让你
违背承诺，所以在
你支付我
你答应过的
500,000 Zeny之前，
我不会把扩音器给你。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Thanks for escorting
my Dancers over to the
Schwarzwald Republic.
Anything I can help
you with today?
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
谢谢你护送
我的舞娘们去
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国。
今天还有什么
我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I'd like another Megaphone.
scripts.translation: 我想再要一个扩音器。

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Well, I guess I can let
you have another one if
you pay me 500,000 zeny.
You sure you want to pay
the money for a Megaphone?
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
嗯，如果你愿意
付我500,000 Zeny，
我想我可以再给你一个。
你确定要花钱
买一个扩音器吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
I'm sorry, but this
isn't enough money for
a Megaphone. Be sure
to bring me 500,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
很抱歉，
这点钱不够买
一个扩音器。记得
带500,000 Zeny来。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Here you are. The fact is...
These Megaphones are
considered guild property,
so I'm not supposed to let
you have this. Don't let
anyone know I gave you this!
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
给你。其实...
这些扩音器算是公会的财产，
按规定我不应该给你。
千万别让任何人知道我把这个给你了！

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Alright~
Take care, and
travel safely~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
好的~
保重，
一路顺风~

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Alright~
Take care, and
travel safely~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
好的~
保重，
一路顺风~

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Trust me, we've made
good use of the money
that you've ''donated.''
Thanks for taking good
care of my Dancers~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
相信我，
你“捐赠”的钱我们已经好好利用起来了。
谢谢你这么照顾我的舞娘们~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Hi there~
Are you enjoying
yourself? I hope so!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
你好~
玩得开心吗？希望你玩得愉快！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Ah, you must be the
bodyguard. So are you
ready to go now?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
啊，你一定是那位保镖吧。那么，
你准备好出发了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Alright, then.
Here we go~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
好的，那么。
我们出发吧~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
We need to depart soon,
so please hurry. I'll be
waiting for you here~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
我们要出发了，
请快点。我会在这里等你~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Oh, that was such a fun
performance. I can still
see the dazzling decorations
in the ballroom where we got
to dance. It was so wonderful!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
哦，那场表演太有趣了。
我还能看到我们在舞厅跳舞时那些华丽的装饰。
真是太美妙了！

[Dancer]
I guess it's pretty
fun to perform on stage~
But I still need to practice
more for the next performance.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
我觉得在舞台上表演挺有趣的~
但我还需要为下一场表演多加练习。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
I sure learned a lot from
that trip. I hope that the new
girls also gained something
from their experiences.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
那次旅行让我学到了很多。
我希望新来的女孩们也能从经历中有所收获。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Hi there~
Are you enjoying
yourself? I hope so!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
你好~
玩得开心吗？希望你玩得愉快！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
This will be my
first performance...
I guess that's why
I have butterflies
in my stomach...
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
这将是我
第一次表演...
我想这就是为什么
我紧张得心里像有蝴蝶在飞...

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
I wonder which beautiful
place we'll get to perform in
next time! Ooh, I can't wait!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
不知道下次我们会去哪个美丽的地方表演！哦，我等不及了！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Hi there~
Are you enjoying
yourself? I hope so!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
你好~
玩得开心吗？希望你玩得愉快！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
I've performed at many
venues, but this is the
frist time I'll be dancing
in the Schwarzwald Republic.
This is also my first time on
an airship. How exciting!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
我在很多场馆表演过，
但这是第一次在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国跳舞。
这也是我第一次坐飞空艇。好兴奋啊！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Traveling is really
thrilling... It's almost as
fun as dancing on stage~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
旅行真的很刺激...
几乎和在舞台上跳舞一样有趣~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Hi there~
Are you enjoying
yourself? I hope so!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
你好~
玩得开心吗？希望你玩得愉快！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
This is the first time that
the Schwarzwald Republic
requested a performance
from us. Isn't that amazing?
I guess we earned a reputation
overseas. I'll do my best!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
这是修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国
第一次邀请我们表演。是不是很厉害？
看来我们在海外也打出了名声。我会尽力的！

scripts.text:
[Airship Announcement]
We will be arriving
in Einbroch shortly.
Passengers to Einbroch,
please get ready to land.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇广播]
我们将很快抵达艾音布罗克。
前往艾音布罗克的乘客，
请做好降落准备。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Oh! We're finally here!
Alright, I'll give this next
performance my all!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
哦！我们终于到了！
好了，我会全力以赴完成接下来的表演！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
I've been dancing on
stage for a long time, but
I always feel so nervous
right beforehand. I wonder
why that happens to me.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
我在舞台上跳舞很久了，
但每次上台前还是会感到紧张。
不知道为什么会这样。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Oh, the dinner
party isn't finished yet.
It'll be over before
you even know it~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
哦，晚宴还没结束呢。
不知不觉就会结束的~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Hooray! My first
onstage performance
was a success! Oh
I was so nervous...
But I'm so proud
of myself now!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
万岁！我的第一次
舞台表演成功了！哦
我刚才好紧张...
但现在我为自己感到骄傲！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Without dance,
my life has no
meaning at all.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
没有舞蹈，
我的生命就毫无意义。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
The dinner party isn't
even finished yet, but
I'm already exhausted~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
晚宴还没结束呢，
但我已经累坏了~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
^333333*Whew*^000000 We gave a good
performance this time.
I was worried since that
airship trip really drained me.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
^333333*呼*^000000 这次的表演很成功。
之前坐飞空艇真的让我精疲力竭，
所以我很担心。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Dancing is really
hard work, and all that
practicing wears you out,
but it's worth it once you
get up on that stage.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
跳舞真的很辛苦，
不断的练习也会让人疲惫，
但一旦登上舞台，
一切都值得了。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Oh, the dinner
party isn't finished yet.
It'll be over before
you even know it~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
哦，晚宴还没结束呢。
不知不觉就会结束的~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Well well, it looks like our
performance was a success.
The new girls did a really
great job. So let's head
back home, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
哎呀，看来我们的表演很成功。
新来的女孩们表现得非常出色。
那么，我们回家吧？

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Dancing is so fun, but
sometimes it's hard to
keep up with the audience's
expectations, you know?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
跳舞很有趣，
但有时候很难跟上
观众们的期望，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
It'd be a really great
party if our customers
were a little less rowdy
Recently, they've been
more than a handful...
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
如果顾客们能稍微
安静一点就好了。
最近他们真的让人
有点难以招架...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
I'm glad our customers
enjoyed the performance
I was a little worried about
what they were going to think,
but I guess I was just being
overly anxious about it all.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
很高兴顾客们
喜欢这场表演。
我原本有点担心
他们的看法，
看来是我多虑了。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Thank you so much for
your services. I'll be sure to
have one of my employees
send you your payment
Have a safe trip back~
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
非常感谢你们的服务。
我会让一位员工
把报酬送过去。
祝你们一路顺风~

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Oh, did you enjoy
your trip? I'm glad to
see that everyone arrived
safely. The dinner party
will start shortly, so
please get ready~
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
哦，旅途愉快吗？
很高兴看到大家都
安全抵达。晚宴即将
开始，请做好准备~

scripts.text:
[Employee]
We've been so busy lately!
It's just one party reservation
after another! When will I be
able to just take a break?
scripts.translation:
[员工]
最近太忙了！
一个接一个的宴会预订！
我什么时候才能
休息一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Employee]
Hi, how may I help you?
Tonight, most of customers
are high ranking government
officials or public figures.
That man over there is the
Rekenber P.R. executive.
scripts.translation:
[员工]
您好，有什么可以帮您？
今晚，大多数顾客
都是高级政府官员
或公众人物。
那边那位男士是
雷肯贝的公关主管。

scripts.text:
[Employee]
That priest over there is
actually a diplomat from
Arunafeltz on business.
These are some very
important people!
scripts.translation:
[员工]
那边那位牧师
其实是阿鲁纳菲兹
出差来的外交官。
这些都是非常重要的人物！

scripts.text:
[Employee]
How can I help you?
Oh, would you like another
drink? There you go! Please
enjoy the dinner party~
scripts.translation:
[员工]
有什么可以帮您？
哦，您想再来一杯吗？
给您！请享用晚宴~

scripts.text:
[Employee]
Oh, the mess left after
a banquet is the biggest
part of my job. It's tough
work, but it needs to get done.
scripts.translation:
[员工]
哦，宴会后的
清理工作是我工作中
最繁重的一部分。
虽然很辛苦，
但必须做好。

scripts.text:
[????]
I guess the party
will soon be over.
Did you enjoy yourself?
scripts.translation:
[????]
我想宴会
快结束了。
您玩得开心吗？

scripts.text:
[??????]
Yes, thank you, I had
a great time. I'm sorry
I gave you such short
notice of my arrival, but
you held this party anyway.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
是的，谢谢，我玩得很开心。
抱歉我通知得这么突然，
但你们还是举办了这场宴会。

scripts.text:
[????]
Don't mention it.
You're a valued guest.
It would shame me if I'd
failed to entertain you.
scripts.translation:
[????]
别客气。
您是尊贵的客人。
如果没能让您尽兴，
那才是我的耻辱。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Ho ho, you certainly know
how to be a good host~
scripts.translation:
[??????]
呵呵，您真是
一位好主人~

scripts.text:
[????]
Your words honor me.
scripts.translation:
[????]
承蒙夸奖，
不胜荣幸。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe man took a quick
look around the room.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF那名男子迅速环顾了一下四周。^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
No one's around.
I have something to
discuss with you before
we get down to business.
scripts.translation:
[????]
这里没人。
在正事开始之前，
我有件事想和你商量。

scripts.text:
[??????]
What kind of...?

[????]
I'll explain in detail
someplace safer. The gist
is that some rogues over in
Arunafeltz are plotting to harm
relations between Arunafeltz
and the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[????]
我会找个更安全的地方详细解释。
大意是，阿鲁纳菲兹那边有一些流氓，
正在密谋破坏阿鲁纳菲兹
与雷肯贝尔公司之间的关系。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Oh... I see. Yes,
we can't talk about
that here. To tell the
truth, I've suspected that
something like that was
going on... Yes, makes sense.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
哦...我明白了。
是的，我们不能在这里谈论那些。
说实话，我也一直怀疑
会有类似的事情发生...
是的，说得通。

scripts.text:
[????]
We should relocate
so that we can talk
a bit more freely.
Please follow me,
I already have
a place prepared.
scripts.translation:
[????]
我们应该换个地方，
这样说话能更自由些。
请跟我来，
我已经准备好
一个地方了。

scripts.text:
[????]
Hmm... Good.
Everything looks
ready to me.
scripts.translation:
[????]
嗯...很好。
在我看来，一切
都准备就绪了。

scripts.text:
[??????]
I've got to say, only
Rekenber can host such
a magnificent party in
a city this polluted.
What's going on...?
scripts.translation:
[????]
不得不说，只有雷肯贝尔
才能在这座污染严重的城市里
举办如此盛大的宴会。
这是怎么回事...

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Thanks for your help.
This country's government
should know better than to
put a good man like me in jail.
Listen, I'm a fugitive now.
Do you think you can help me?
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
谢谢你的帮助。
这个国家的政府
竟然要把像我这样的好人关进监狱。
听着，我现在是个逃犯。
你觉得你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: I may as well...
scripts.translation: 我也可以...

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
I just need you to talk
to a few people, and let
me know what they said.
I'd do it myself, but you
understand that I've got
to keep a low profile.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
我只需要你找几个人谈谈，
然后告诉我他们说了什么。
我自己去也行，但你知道的，
我必须保持低调。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Please meet these people
in the order that I tell you.
I've sent messengers to let
them know of your arrival,
but I had to send them out
at different times... Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
请按照我告诉你的顺序
去见这些人。
我已经派信使去通知他们
你的到来，
但我不得不让他们在不同时间出发...
总之...

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
First, go to Prontera
and talk to Chada. Second,
go to Geffen and speak to
Ghez. Lastly, please go to
Comodo and meet Nosdan.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
首先，去普隆德拉找查达。
其次，去吉芬找盖兹。
最后，请去克魔岛找诺斯丹。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Each one of them will
sing you a song. Listen
carefully, and sing me their
songs when you come back.
Thanks, you have no idea how
much I appreciate your help.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
他们每个人都会给你唱一首歌。
仔细听，等你回来时
把他们的歌唱给我听。
谢谢，你不知道
我有多感激你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Chada is probably near
the middle of Prontera.
The messenger I sent to
him should have reached
him by now, so he should
be expecting your arrival.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
查达可能在普隆德拉的中间位置。
我派给他的信使
应该已经到达那里了，
所以他应该正在期待你的到来。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Ah, now you've got to
talk to Ghez. He should
be in Northeast Geffen
somewhere. Hopefully
you won't have too much
trouble finding him.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
啊，现在你得去找盖兹了。
他应该在吉芬的东北方某处。
希望你能顺利找到他。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Trying to find Nosdan?
I think he's probably in the
Northern Cave in Comodo.
Please talk to him, and let
me know about his song.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
在找诺斯丹吗？
我想他可能在克魔岛的北方洞穴里。
请和他谈谈，
并告诉我他的歌。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Welcome back.
So did you listen
to all of their songs?
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
欢迎回来。
那么，你听完了
他们所有的歌吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Perfect~ Here's a little
something to show my
gratitude. Hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
完美~ 这里有一点小东西
以表谢意。希望你喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Now, tell me, what
exactly did they si--
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
现在，告诉我，
他们到底唱了什--

scripts.text:
[????]
Hold it!

[Vitre]
What? Wh-who the
hell are you guys?!
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
什么？你...你们到底是
哪路神仙？！

scripts.text:
[????]
Rune-Midgarts
Secret Service!
Vitre Bizlleta--
you're under arrest
for espionage!
scripts.translation:
[???]
卢恩·米德加兹
秘密服务处！
维特雷·比兹莱塔--
你因涉嫌间谍罪
被捕了！

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Again? Didn't you just
arrest me just for being
suspected of espionage?
I think it's a little unfair
to just capture me when
you don't have any proof.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
又来？你们刚才
不是才因为“涉嫌”间谍罪
抓过我吗？
在没有证据的情况下
就这样抓人，
我觉得有点不公平吧。

scripts.text:
[????]
We just seized concrete
evidence of your illegal
activities. It's probably
enough to imprison you
for life. Happy now?
scripts.translation:
[???]
我们刚刚查获了你
非法活动的确凿证据。
这足以让你
被判终身监禁。
满意了吗？

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
You're bluffing.
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
你们在虚张声势。

scripts.text:
[????]
You shouldn't have sent
that unsuspecting adventurer
to your news sources. We've
taken them into custody
Chada, Ghez, Nosdan.
That's them, right?
scripts.translation:
[???]
你不该派那个
毫无戒心的冒险者
去接触你的情报源。
我们已经将他们
全部逮捕了。
查达、盖兹、诺斯丹。
就是他们，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Nooooooooo!

[Suden]
Adventurer, thank you for
your cooperation. I am
Suden Griea, Secret Service
agent. I'm sure you have
a lot of questions, but ^FF0000Lasda
Midar^000000 will answer them.
scripts.translation:
[苏登]
冒险者，感谢你的配合。
我是苏登·格里亚，
秘密服务处的特工。
我相信你有很多疑问，
但^FF0000拉斯达
米达尔^000000会回答你的。

scripts.text:
[Suden]
I'd explain here and now,
but I better dispose of
this trash with the rest of
his scum buddies... in jail!
scripts.translation:
[苏登]
我现在就解释，
但我最好先把这堆垃圾
和他那群狐朋狗友一起...
扔进监狱！

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Would you please hurry?
Staying in one place like
this makes me nervous...
I should be on the move...
scripts.translation:
[维特雷]
请快点好吗？

trouble finding
your way back home?

^333333*Sniff sniff*^000000 Uuuuuuweeeh~

找到回家的路！

street, and ask him to help
