嗯...如果我想帮卡琳
解救她的妹妹卡迪，
最好去找艾薇女士，
那个有机肥皂制造商。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait... I should be
bringing Ms. Ivory all
of the soap ingredients.
What were they again...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...我应该
给艾薇女士带齐
所有的肥皂原料。
那些是什么来着...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF10 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF100 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Jellopies^000000, and
^4D4DFF5 Empty Bottles^000000.
I better get those...

[{0}]
I need to talk to
someone named Saraman
to get the soap ingredients...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我需要找个人
叫萨拉曼，
去获取肥皂原料...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
I need to bring
Mr. Saruman all the
things he needs to
stimulate a camel's 
appetite. I need to get...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我想想...
我需要给萨拉曼先生
带齐他需要的东西，
以刺激骆驼的食欲。
我需要去弄...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF1 Unripe Apple^000000,
^4D4DFF5 Monster's Feed^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Empty Bottle^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Potion^000000.

[{0}]
I have everything I need
to stimulate a camel's
appetite. Now I need to
feed the camel so that I can
get the soap ingredients and
5 lumps of camel dung.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已经备齐了
刺激骆驼食欲的东西。
现在我需要喂骆驼，
这样才能拿到肥皂原料
和5块骆驼粪便。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right now, my time
would be better spent
looking for the Silk Sand
Camel for the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在，我的时间
最好用来寻找
丝绸沙骆驼，
以获取原料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd better find Mr. Saraman's
lost camel, feed it camel
appetite stimulants, and
then get the soap ingredient
and 5 lumps of camel dung
if I want to free Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得找到萨拉曼先生
丢失的骆驼，喂它
骆驼开胃剂，
然后拿到肥皂原料
和5块骆驼粪便，
这样才能解救卡迪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I found the
camel. Now I need to get
all the soap ingredients.
The sooner I do that, the
sooner I can help Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我找到了
骆驼。现在我需要
集齐所有的肥皂原料。
越快完成，
我就能越快帮到卡迪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I managed to get the soap
ingredient and 5 of those
camel dung lumps. I should
head back to Mr. Saraman to
tell him where his camel is,
and then go to Ms. Ivory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了肥皂原料
和5块骆驼粪便。
我该回去告诉萨拉曼先生
他的骆驼在哪里，
然后再去找艾芙丽小姐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
Shouldn't I be going
to see Ms. Ivory now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我想想...
我现在应该
去找艾芙丽小姐吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have the Silk Sand Camel
Soap now, so I should go
bring it to Mr. Lockenlock.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我现在有了丝沙骆驼肥皂，
应该把它带给洛肯洛克先生。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd better use the soap to
make a key mold that I can
bring over to Mr. Lockenlock.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我最好用肥皂
做一个钥匙模具，
然后带给洛肯洛克先生。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Making the key is more
important that telling Karyn
about what's happened.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
制作钥匙比告诉卡琳
发生了什么更重要。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to bring
1 Steel to Mr. Lockenlock
so that he can make a key
that will finally free Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我需要带1块钢铁
给洛肯洛克先生，
让他制作一把钥匙，
这样才能解救卡迪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I finally got the
key that I can use
to free Curdie. I'm
gonna go save her now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我终于拿到了
可以解救卡迪的钥匙。
我现在就去救她。

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Thank you so much!
Please bring back Curdie
as soon as you can! ^333333*Sob*^000000
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
非常感谢你！
请快点把卡迪带回来！
^333333*抽泣*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, Karyn! I sent
your sister back to town
with a Butterfly Wing.
Did she come back safe?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，卡琳！我派你姐姐
带着蝴蝶翅膀回城镇了。
她安全回来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Yes, Curdie's back
and she's resting in
the hospital right now.
Thank you so much for
all of your help!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
是的，卡迪回来了，
她正在医院休息。
非常感谢你的帮助！

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
I'm not sure what's wrong
with Curdie, though. Ever
since she got back, she gets
frightened whenever she
sees the soldiers in town.
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
不过我不清楚卡迪怎么了。
自从她回来，每次看到
城镇里的士兵都会害怕。

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
I promise to tell my dad
about what you did after he
comes back from overseas.
Thank you for everything
that you did for us!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
我答应爸爸，等他
从海外回来就告诉他
你做的事。
谢谢你为我们做的一切！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm... I see...
I'll come by later
when Curdie's released
from the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我知道了。
等卡迪出院后
我会再来看她的。

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Yes, please do.
I promise to help you
whenever you need me!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
好的，请一定来。
我答应你，只要你需要，
我都会帮忙！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hahahaha!
Well... I guess that's
pretty reassuring. Until then,
take good care of your mother
and sister. You got that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈哈！
嗯...那还挺让人安心的。
在那之前，
照顾好你的母亲和姐姐。
记住了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Got it!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
记住了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good, good...
It's a promise, then.
I'll see you later~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好，很好...
那就说定了。
回头见~

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Oh, hello! Thank you
so much for helping me
last time! When I get
older, I'm gonna do my
best to help you the same
way that you helped me!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
哦，你好！
上次谢谢你帮我！
等我长大了，
我会尽力像你帮助我那样
去帮助别人！

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Hi! It's good to see
you again! Kurdi just came
back home from the hospital,
and is getting better everyday!
Ah, and I've been taking care
of her, just like I promised~
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
嗨！很高兴再见到你！
卡迪刚从医院回家，
每天都好多了！
啊，而且我一直在照顾她，
就像我答应的那样~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really? That's good
You should be proud~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的吗？那很好。
你应该感到自豪~

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
^666666*Blush*^000000 Heh heh!

[{0}]
Anyway, I was wondering
if you could help me.
Your dad's a fisherman,
right? Would you mind
asking him if I could
borrow his boat?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对了，我想请你帮个忙。
你爸爸是渔夫，对吧？
能不能麻烦你问问他，
我能不能借用他的船？

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Well... Actually...
The pope said that my
dad isn't allowed to use
his boat for a while...
I'm not sure why...
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
嗯...其实...
教皇说，我爸爸暂时
不能使用他的船...
我不太清楚为什么...

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
So yeah. Dad's not allowed
to go out to sea right now.
But it should be okay if it's
you, right? Hey, you helped
me, so I hafta help you, right?
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
所以呢。爸爸现在不能出海。
但如果是你的话，应该没问题吧？
嘿，你帮过我，所以我得帮你，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
My dad is really mad that
he can't use his boat so
maybe we better not tell
him you want to use it. Let's
keep it our secret, okay?
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
我爸爸因为不能用船很生气，
所以最好别告诉他你想用船。
让我们保守这个秘密，好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
S-sure thing!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当...当然没问题！

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Anyway, his boat is the
only one on the south beach
since all the other fishermen
dock theirs boats in other
places. Also, my dad's boat
will rust if no one uses it.
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
总之，他的船是南边海滩上唯一的一艘，
因为其他渔夫都把船停泊在别处。
而且，如果没人使用，我爸爸的船会生锈的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Great! Thanks so much
for your help, Karyn~
I'll be sure to take
good care of your dad's
boat. I only need it for
a little while, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太好了！非常感谢你的帮助，卡琳~
我会好好照顾你爸爸的船。
反正我只需要借用一小会儿。

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Heh heh! Thanks!
I'm happy that
I can help you too!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
嘿嘿！谢谢！
我也很高兴能帮到你！

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Hi! How do you like
fishing on my dad's boat?
Oh, and Kurdi says hi!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
嗨！在我爸爸的船上钓鱼感觉怎么样？
哦，柯迪向你问好！

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Dad says that he'll
be able to go fishing
again soon! I hope that
he'll catch a lot of fish!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
爸爸说，他很快就能
再次去钓鱼了！
希望他能钓到很多鱼！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou come across
a little girl lying on the
ground unconscious.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现一个小女孩躺在地上，
失去了意识。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, kid! Wake up!
Can you hear me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，小孩！醒醒！
你能听到我说话吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFShe has a pulse, but
despite your verbal
entreaties, she won't
open her eyes. You
lightly slap her cheek
to wake her up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF她有脉搏，但尽管你不断呼唤，
她依然没有睁开眼睛。你轻轻拍了拍她的脸颊，
试图唤醒她。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Huh?!
...Ah, owwww~
W-waaaaaaaah!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
嗯？！
...啊，好痛~
哇...哇啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sorry! I didn't mean
to make you cry! Are...
Are you alright?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对不起！我不是故意让你哭的！你...
你没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Huh? Wh-who are you?
Oh no, you have to get
out of here! You'll be in
trouble if they catch you!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
嗯？你...你是谁？
糟糕，你必须马上离开这里！
如果被他们抓到，你就麻烦了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you Curdie?
Your brother Karyn
asked me to rescue you.
Come on, we've got to
get you out of here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是柯迪吗？
你哥哥卡琳让我来救你。
快起来，我们必须带你离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Karyn...?
Oh, oh no! I... They
locked me in these
shackles and I can't move!
You have to leave before
those scary men come back!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
卡琳...？
啊，糟糕！我...他们
用脚炼锁住了我，我动不了！
你必须在那些可怕的人回来之前离开！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...?!
Those bastards!
Tying up a little
girl like this...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什么？！
这群混蛋！
竟然把一个小女孩
绑成这样...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Argh! And I can't just
use brute force to shatter
these shackles! I might
end up hurting you...!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可恶！我不能
直接用蛮力砸碎
这些脚炼！
万一伤到你怎么办...

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Don't worry about me...
Just hurry and leave!
I... I'll be alright! Now
hurry! Someone's coming!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
别担心我...
快离开这里！
我...我会没事的！
快走吧！有人来了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, I'll go...
But sit tight, and
wait for me to come
back. I'll figure out
some way to free you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我走了...
但你乖乖待在这里，
等我回来。
我会想办法
解开你的脚炼的。

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
^333333*Sob*^000000 R-really...?

[{0}]
I promise.
I'm sure that someone
in town will know of a way
to unlock your shackles.
I'll be back as soon as I can!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我保证。
镇上一定有人知道
怎么解开你的脚炼。
我会尽快回来的！

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomeone in town
must have the
expertise to unlock
these shackles. It's your
only hope to free Curdie
from these chains.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF镇上一定有人
懂得如何解开
这些脚炼。这是你
解救柯迪的唯一希望。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie is lying
feebly on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF柯迪虚弱地
躺在地上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
I hate the metal
clanging sounds...
Th-the sparks,
they're... They're...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
我讨厌金属
碰撞的声音...
那...那火花，
它们...它们...

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie is curled up on
the ground, eyes tightly
shut, her entire body
trembling with fear.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF柯迪蜷缩在地上，
紧闭双眼，
全身因恐惧而颤抖。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOn the ground, you see
some equipment that looks
similarly to that used by
the Rachel soldiers.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地上散落着一些
看起来像是
拉赫士兵使用的
装备。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt seems that someone
has come by to give
Curdie food and water.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看来有人来过，
给柯迪留下了
食物和水。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie squints at you
as you walk by. It seems
that her vision gets worse
the longer she's locked
up in this cave.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你走过时，
柯迪眯着眼看你。
看来她被关在这个
洞穴里的时间越长，
视力就越差。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better find the
Silk Sand Camel and get
the soap ingredients if
you really want to free
Curdie from her shackles.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF如果你真的想
解开柯迪的脚炼，
最好去找丝沙骆驼，
并收集肥皂原料。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd better find Mr. Saraman's
lost camel, feed it camel
appetite stimulants, and
then get the soap ingredient
and 5 lumps of camel dung
if I want to free Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得找到萨拉曼先生
丢失的骆驼，喂它
骆驼开胃剂，
然后拿到肥皂原料
和5块骆驼粪便，
这样才能解救卡迪。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou already found the
camel, so you need to collect
the soap ingredients if you
want to free Curdie.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF既然你已经找到了骆驼，
那么如果你真想
解开柯迪的脚炼，
就需要收集肥皂原料。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I managed to get the soap
ingredients: 5 of those
camel dung lumps. I should
head back to Mr. Saraman to
tell him where his camel is,
and then go to Ms. Ivory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了肥皂原料：
5块骆驼粪便。
我应该回去告诉萨拉曼
他的骆驼在哪里，
然后再去找艾芙丽女士。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou should be leaving
to see Ms. Ivory now if
you really want to free
Curdie from her shackles.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF如果你真的想
解开柯迪的脚炼，
现在应该去找艾芙丽女士。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow that you have the
Silk Sand Camel Soap,
you should bring it
over to Mr. Lockenlock.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF既然你已经拿到了
丝沙骆驼肥皂，
你应该把它带给洛肯洛克。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie is exactly
where you left her.
There's a bowl of cold
soup next to her, so it's
clear that someone has
been feeding her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF柯迪还留在原地。
她旁边有一碗冷汤，
看来一直有人在
照顾她。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pour the soap into
the shackle's lock to create
a mold that Mr. Lockenlock
can use to make a key.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你将肥皂倒入脚炼的锁孔中，
制作出一个模具，
以便洛肯洛克
用它来制作钥匙。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Will...
Will I always
be stuck here?
I... I want my mommy...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
我...我会永远
被困在这里吗？
我...我想妈妈了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... You're awake?
Don't worry, Curdie,
I'm sure that I'll be
able to get you free soon.
Try to hold on a bit longer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...你醒了？
别担心，柯迪，
我相信很快就能
把你救出去的。
再坚持一下。

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
When the door is open,
I see blazing flames...
And I hear... the sound
of machines? These men
wearing the same clothes
keep marching past me...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
门打开的时候，
我看到熊熊烈火...
还听到...机器的声音？
那些穿着同样衣服的人
一直从我面前走过...

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
I... They scare me so much!
Th-the man that brings me
food says that they won't
let me go because of what
I saw inside there. They...
They won't let be go home...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
我...他们好可怕！
那个给我送饭的男人说，
因为我看到了里面的东西，
他们不让我走。他们...
不让我回家...

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie's eyes are
disfocused and are
pointed above your head.
She might not survive if
she's forced to remain
here for much longer.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF柯迪的眼神涣散，
望着你的头顶上方。
如果她再在这里待太久，
可能活不下去了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry.
I'll come rescue
you as soon as I make
the key to unlock these
awful shackles. Don't worry...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别担心。
等我做好打开这副
可怕脚炼的钥匙，
就会来救你的。别担心...

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
If I'm not here the
next time you come,
then just run away.
Don't even tell my brother.
Get far away before they
can catch you. I-I'm serious...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
如果我下次你来的时候
不在这里了，
那就快跑吧。
连我哥哥都不要告诉。
在他们抓住你之前
跑得远远的。我是认真的...

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Even if I don't see you
again... I just... I just
want to thank you for doing
your best to help me.
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
即使再也见不到你...
我也...我只想谢谢你
尽力帮助我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Everything will be
alright. I just have
to hurry a little bit.
Alright, it's time to go.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一切都会好起来的。
我只是需要加快速度。
好了，该走了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou extract the soap
from the lock, and
carefully wrap it.
Now you need to take
the mold back to town
to Mr. Lockenlock.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你从锁孔中取出肥皂，
小心地包裹好。
现在你需要带着模具
回到城镇，去找洛肯洛克。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have to hurry back
to town and bring the
key mold to Mr. Lockenlock
so that he can make a key
to unlock Curdie's shackles.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你必须尽快回到城镇，
把钥匙模具带给洛肯洛克，
让他制作一把钥匙，
解开柯迪的脚炼。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Y-you...
Is it really you?
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
你...你...
真的是你吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hang on, Curdie!
I hope this key works...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
坚持住，柯迪！
希望这把钥匙能打开...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou unlock the
shackles with
Mr. Lockenlock's key.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你用洛肯洛克的钥匙
解开了脚炼。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Aaaah!
M-my... My...!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
啊！
我的...我的...！

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie's legs are
swollen from the
weight and pressure
of wearing the shackles
for such a long time.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF柯迪的双腿因为长期
佩戴脚炼的重量和压力
而肿胀。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
I can't move my legs!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
我的腿动不了了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, there's no other
choice. Curdie, I'm
going to send you back to
town with a Butterfly Wing.
Try not to move, alright?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来没有其他选择了。
柯迪，我要用蝴蝶翅膀
把你送回城镇。
试着不要乱动，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Oh! Thank you...
I... I can go home...
Thank you s-so much...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
哦！谢谢你...
我...我可以回家了...
太...太感谢你了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou use the power
of a Butterfly Wing to
send Curdie back to
town. Hopefully, she'll
arrive safely and see
her brother Karyn again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你使用蝴蝶翅膀的力量
将柯迪送回了城镇。
希望她能平安抵达，
再次见到她的哥哥卡琳。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What did she see behind
the steel door in this old
volcano? It must have been
dangerous... Something
related to the Rachel Army...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她在火山深处的铁门后
看到了什么？那里一定很危险...
可能与拉赫军队有关...

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
 ...Wah....

^3355FFIt's a drunkard...
The scent of pure
alcohol wafts around him.
There's a certain beauty
to his disheveled misery.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF是个酒鬼...
他身上散发着
纯酒精的气味。
他那凌乱落魄的模样
竟透着一种独特的美感。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...?

[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Huh? Arrrgh...
My head... What
do you want?
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
嗯？啊...
我的头...你想干什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I'd like
to make a key.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我想
配一把钥匙。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Keys? Yeah, yeah...
That's what I do.
If you've got the lock,
it'll be a piece of cake.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
钥匙？对对对...
那是我的老本行。
如果你有锁，
那简直是小菜一碟。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Ugh, but I'm so thirsty
and this headache is
killing me. You mind
bringing me a Yellow
Potion first?
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
唉，但我太渴了，
这头痛得要命。
你介意先给我
带一瓶黄色药水吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure, I guess.
I can part with just
1 Yellow Potion.
Here you go.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我想。
我可以拿出一瓶
黄色药水。
给你。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Ah, that hit the spot!
Wait, wait... Now I feel
dizzy... What's going...
What's going on...?
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
啊，真解渴！
等等，等等...我现在
有点头晕...怎么回事...
发生什么事了...？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Okay, okay...
I'm alright now.
So what'd you say you
needed? A key? Did you
bring the lock with you?
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
好了，好了...
我现在没事了。
刚才你说你需要什么？
钥匙？你带锁
过来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
I'm an expert in crafting
keys and locks. Hell, my locks
are strong enough to hold down
a dragon, you know that? I'll
have you know that the Rachel
Army's a regular customer~
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
我是制作钥匙和锁的专家。
天哪，我的锁坚固到
足以困住一条龙，你知道吗？
顺便告诉你，拉赫军队
可是我的常客哦~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333This guy made locks for
the Rachel army?! It might
not be a good idea to let him
know that I'm trying to free
one of their prisoners. Who
knows if he's loyal to them?^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^333333这家伙给拉赫军队
做锁？！也许不该让他知道
我正在试图解救
他们的一名囚犯。
谁知道他是否忠于他们？^000000)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So what happened was...
I lost my key, but I can't
bring the lock here with me.
I think I'd end up breaking
it if I brought it with me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
事情是这样的...
我弄丢了钥匙，但我
没法把锁带到这里。
我觉得如果我把它带过来，
可能会把它弄坏。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Oh, yeah? No problem.
Just take me to the lock.
I'll charge you extra, though,
especially since my knees
are going bad. So where
are we going exactly?
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
哦，是吗？没问题。
带我去看看锁。
不过我要额外收费，
毕竟我的膝盖不太好。
那我们具体要去哪里？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait!
We can't do that!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！
我们不能那样做！

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
What do you mean?
You're not trying to
open up a bank safe
or something, are you?
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
你什么意思？
你不会是想
打开银行保险柜之类的吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it's nothing like
that! It's just that the lock
is in a dangerous place.
This is really important...
Please, you have to help me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，完全不是那样！
只是那把锁在一个
危险的地方。
这真的很重要...
拜托，你一定要帮我！

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Huh. Well, bottom line,
I can't make a key without
looking at the lock. Let me
think of a way I can help you.
Give me a second, will you?
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
嗯。总之，
不看锁我是没法配钥匙的。
让我想想怎么帮你。
给我一点时间，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
...............................
Well, I guess you can try
to make a mold of the lock.
It'll have to be perfect, so
this'll get pretty expensive.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
...............................
嗯，我想你可以尝试
制作锁的模具。
它必须完美无缺，
所以这会相当昂贵。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Go to the market and
find a lady selling organic
soap. You need to get a bottle
of Chamelepu Soap. You will
need that exact type of soap:
nothing else will do.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
去市场找一位卖有机肥皂的女士。
你需要买一瓶变色龙肥皂。
必须是那种肥皂：
别的都不行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Chamelpu Soap?
What is th--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
变色龙肥皂？
那是什么——

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
No time to explain.
You'd better hurry and
find her before she closes
shop for the day. The shop
owner's a beauty, so it'll
be tough for you to miss her.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
没时间解释了。
你最好快点去找她，
趁她还没收摊。
店主是个美人，
你肯定一眼就能认出她。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a drunkard...
This man must be the
Mr. Lockenlock that you seek.
You'd better follow Toby's
advice and bring this man
a Yellow Potion first.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF是个酒鬼...
这个人应该就是你找的
洛肯洛克先生。
你最好听从托比的建议，
先给这个人带一瓶黄色药水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Go to the market and
find a lady selling organic
soap, and get a bottle of
Chamelepu Soap. You will
need that exact type of soap:
nothing else will do.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
去市场找一位卖有机肥皂的女士，
买一瓶变色龙肥皂。
必须是那种肥皂：
别的都不行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Chamelpu Soap?
What is th--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
变色龙肥皂？
那是什么——

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
No time to explain.
You'd better hurry and
find her before she closes
shop for the day. The shop
owner's a beauty, so it'll
be tough for you to miss her.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
没时间解释了。
你最好快点去找她，
趁她还没收摊。
店主是个美人，
你肯定一眼就能认出她。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait... I should be
bringing Ms. Ivory all
of the soap ingredients.
What were they again...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...我应该
给艾薇女士带齐
所有的肥皂原料。
那些是什么来着...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF10 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF100 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Jellopies^000000, and
^4D4DFF5 Empty Bottles^000000.
I better get those...

[{0}]
I need to talk to
someone named Saraman
to get the soap ingredients...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我需要找个人
叫萨拉曼，
去获取肥皂原料...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
I need to bring
Mr. Saruman all the
things he needs to
stimulate a camel's 
appetite. I need to get...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我想想...
我需要给萨拉曼先生
带齐他需要的东西，
以刺激骆驼的食欲。
我需要去弄...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF1 Unripe Apple^000000,
^4D4DFF5 Monster's Feed^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Empty Bottle^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Potion^000000.

[{0}]
I have everything I need
to stimulate a camel's
appetite. Now I need to
feed the camel so that I can
get the soap ingredients and
5 lumps of camel dung.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已经备齐了
刺激骆驼食欲的东西。
现在我需要喂骆驼，
这样才能拿到肥皂原料
和5块骆驼粪便。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right now, my time
would be better spent
looking for the Silk Sand
Camel for the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在，我的时间
最好用来寻找
丝绸沙骆驼，
以获取原料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd better find Mr. Saraman's
lost camel, feed it camel
appetite stimulants, and
then get the soap ingredient
and 5 lumps of camel dung
if I want to free Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得找到萨拉曼先生
丢失的骆驼，喂它
骆驼开胃剂，
然后拿到肥皂原料
和5块骆驼粪便，
这样才能解救卡迪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I found the
camel. Now I need to get
all the soap ingredients.
The sooner I do that, the
sooner I can help Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我找到了
骆驼。现在我需要
集齐所有的肥皂原料。
越快完成，
我就能越快帮到卡迪。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou already found the
camel, so you need to collect
the soap ingredients if you
want to free Curdie.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF既然你已经找到了骆驼，
那么如果你真想
解开柯迪的脚炼，
就需要收集肥皂原料。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I managed to get the soap
ingredients: 5 of those
camel dung lumps. I should
head back to Mr. Saraman to
tell him where his camel is,
and then go to Ms. Ivory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了肥皂原料：
5块骆驼粪便。
我应该回去告诉萨拉曼
他的骆驼在哪里，
然后再去找艾芙丽女士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
Shouldn't I be going
to see Ms. Ivory now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我想想...
我现在应该
去找艾芙丽小姐吗？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Oh, so you're finally
back with the Chamelpu
Soap. What took so long?
All you had to do was go
to the market and buy it.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
哦，你终于带着变色龙肥皂
回来了。怎么花了这么久？
你只需要去市场买就行了。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Uh, anyway, did Ms. Ivory
tell you how to use the soap?
You just pour it into the
keyhole, and then pour the
soap back into the bottle.
Do it carefully and quickly.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
呃，总之，艾芙丽小姐
有没有告诉你怎么用肥皂？
你只需要把它倒进锁孔，
然后再倒回瓶子里。
动作要轻快。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Make sure you close the
bottle tightly when you're
done so no air gets into it.
If you take more than thirty
seconds, the soap won't retain
the lock's shape very well.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
做完后一定要把瓶盖拧紧，
别让空气进去。
如果你超过三十秒，
肥皂就无法很好地
保留锁的形状了。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Pour the liquid soap to the key hole in the lock,
pour the soap back to the bottle.
and close the lid so tightly that the air wouldn't go inside the bottle.
Remember, you can't take longer than 30 seconds to finish the procedures.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
把液态肥皂倒进锁孔，
再把肥皂倒回瓶子里。
然后拧紧瓶盖，确保空气进不去。
记住，完成这些步骤不能超过30秒。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Finally, bring the bottle
back here for me so that
I can make the key. But when
you come back, I need to make
sure that the key you're making
isn't for anything illegal...
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
最后，把瓶子带回来给我，
这样我才能配钥匙。不过等你回来时，
我得确认你配的钥匙
不是用于非法用途...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.

[{0}]
I'd better use the soap to
make a key mold that I can
bring over to Mr. Lockenlock.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我最好用肥皂
做一个钥匙模具，
然后带给洛肯洛克先生。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Oh, you're back...
So did you manage
to make the key mold?
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
哦，你回来了...
那么，你成功
制作出钥匙模具了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I did. Would you
please hurry? This is an
emergency, and it could
get really bad if I don't
get this key made soon...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我做到了。请快点好吗？
这是紧急情况，
如果我不尽快拿到这把钥匙，
情况可能会变得非常糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Let me see... Well,
it's not really perfect, but
I should be able to fashion
a key for this lock. Ooh...
But you know what? I don't
have any materials on me.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
让我看看...嗯，
虽然不是很完美，
但我应该能为这把锁
配一把钥匙。噢...
不过你知道吗？我身上
没有材料。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
I've already made all
the keys and locks for this
town, so no one's really had
to send in any orders lately.
That's why I didn't have any
materials onhand. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
我已经为这座城镇
配好了所有的钥匙和锁，
所以最近没人
需要下单定制。
因此我手头没有材料。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
All I need is ^4D4DFF1 Steel^000000.
It won't take me more
than five minutes to make
the key, so I can get it done
as soon as you can bring
me the Steel. I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
我只需要^4D4DFF1块钢^000000。
配钥匙不会超过五分钟，
所以只要你把钢带给我，
我马上就能做好。我会等你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here's the Steel that
you need. Would you
please make the key now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是你需要的钢。
请现在帮我配钥匙好吗？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
...............................
I've been studying
this key mold, and
I just realized something...
Tell me right now: what
are you using this key for?
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
...............................
我一直在研究
这个钥匙模具，
我突然意识到一件事...
现在告诉我：
你打算用这把钥匙做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
What are you...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
诶...？
你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
I asked you first.
Tell me what you intend
to do with this key! If you
don't, I can't help you.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
是我先问你的。
告诉我你打算用这把钥匙做什么！
如果你不说，我就不能帮你。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Don't lie to me.
This mold... This is
the lock for the shackles
that I've made under the
orders of the Rachel Army.
I have the master key for that.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
别骗我。
这个模具...这是
拉赫军队委托我制作的
脚炼的锁。
我手里有那把万能钥匙。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
These shackles are only
supposed to be used for
prisoners! If I release one
of them, they will hunt you
down and hold me accountable.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
这些脚炼
只能用于囚犯！
如果我释放了其中一个，
他们会追捕你，
并追究我的责任。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The truth is... I really
am trying to free somebody
the Rachel Army imprisoned...
She's Curdie, a young girl
that they locked up in
Thor Volcano...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
事实是...我确实
想救一个被拉赫军队
关押的人...
她是柯迪，一个被关在
火山里的年轻女孩...

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
What...?!

I'm sorry. You shouldn't

什...么？！
你是认真的吗？

你没有在撒谎。这...
对不起。你不该卷入这件事，但是...

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Oh God!
They... They
really imprisoned
an innocent child?!

天哪！
他们...他们
真的把一个无辜的孩子
关起来了？！

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Here. Take it.
Take the master key.
Bring it to Thor Volcano
and rescue that poor kid.
We could get in a lot of
trouble for doing this, but...
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
给你。拿着。
拿着这把万能钥匙。
带去火山，
救出那个可怜的孩子。
这样做我们可能会惹上大麻烦，但是...

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
My conscience won't allow
them to do something like
this. Rescue that kid, and
then throw the key away
somewhere when you're done.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
我的良心
不允许他们这样做。
救出那个孩子，
然后做完事之后
把钥匙扔掉。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
That way, if the army
comes to interrogate me,
I'll just say that it was
stolen from my shop by
some thief. I should get
rid of all my keys too...
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
这样，如果军队
来审问我，
我就说是被某个盗贼
从店里偷走的。我也应该
把所有钥匙都处理掉...

scripts.text:

Make sure that you
bring that child back
safe to her family!
scripts.translation:

快去吧！
一定要把那个孩子
平安地带回家人身边！

me the Steel. I'll be waiting.

我马上就能做好。我会等你的。

Curdie. She's safely back
in town. I feel so responsible
about what happened. I mean,
she was locked up in shackles
that I designed for the army.
scripts.translation:

嘿，你救的那个孩子...
柯迪。她平安地
回到了镇上。我对发生的事
感到很自责。毕竟，
她是被我为军队设计的
脚炼锁住的。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Anyway, I'm packing my
things. I'm thinking of
leaving this town for good.
The army's rotten to the core
for doing something like this.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
总之，我正在收拾东西。
我想彻底离开这座城镇。
军队腐朽到了骨子里，
竟然做出这种事。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
You're a real good person,
and I'm glad I got to know
you. I don't know if we'll
ever meet again, but it's
good that there are people
like you in this world.
scripts.translation:
[锁匠 洛肯洛克]
你是个好人，
很高兴能认识你。
我不知道我们是否
还会再见面，但这个世界
有像你这样的人真好。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[洛肯洛克]
呼噜噜...

...呼噜...

scripts.text:
^3355FFHe's drunk and

scripts.translation:
^3355FF他喝醉了，

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
I need to make more of
my soap, but I've run out
of ingredients. Well, there's
not much I can do without them,
so maybe it'd be better if
I just close up shop today...
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
我需要制作更多
我的肥皂，但原料
用完了。嗯，没有原料
我也做不了什么，
所以也许今天
干脆关门比较好...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...?

[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm
closing shop right now
because I just ran out of
soap ingredients. If you
ordered something, then you
could just come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
哦，抱歉，我现在
要关门了，因为
肥皂原料刚用完。如果你
订了东西，
可以明天再来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, this is an emergency!
Mr. Lockenlock told me to
come here to get some kind
of special soap. I need it
to make a mold for him
to make a key for me...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，这是紧急情况！
洛肯洛克先生让我
来这里拿一种特殊的肥皂。
我需要它来给他
做模具，好让他给我
配一把钥匙...

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Oh? You locked yourself
out? Ah, Mr. Lockenlock
must have been talking
about my organic Chamelepu
soap. It's an artistic soap
that you can shape easily~
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
哦？你把自己
锁在外面了？啊，洛肯洛克先生
一定是在说我的
有机变色龙肥皂。
那是一种艺术肥皂，
很容易塑形~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, that's right!
Chamelepu Soap!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，就是那个！
变色龙肥皂！

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
My Chamelepu Soap
is pretty popular. It's
a liquid soap that you can
pour into anything, and it'll
harden into any shape that
you want. Neat, huh?
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
我的变色龙肥皂
很受欢迎。这是一种
液体肥皂，你可以
把它倒进任何东西里，
它就会凝固成
你想要的任何形状。
很厉害吧？

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Well, as I told you earlier,
I ran out of every soap ingredient,
so I cannot make any more soap today.
You should come back tomorrow evening
if you want to buy the soap.
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
嗯，正如我之前告诉你的，
我的肥皂原料都用完了，
所以今天无法再制作肥皂了。
如果你想买肥皂，
最好明天晚上再来。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
If you really need it
right away, I can still
make it for you if can
bring all the ingredients.
They might be a bit hard
to obtain, though...
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
如果你现在
非常急需，只要你
能带来所有原料，
我还可以为你制作。
不过，有些原料
可能不太好找...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's fine. The
important thing for me
is to get this soap as
soon as I possibly can!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系。对我来说，
最重要的是尽快
拿到这块肥皂！

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Alright, first I want
you to bring me the basic
stuff. Bring these items
in the exact amounts I ask
for, alright? Ratios are pretty
important in making soap.
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
好吧，首先我要你
带一些基础材料。
请按照我要求的
确切数量带来，好吗？
制作肥皂时，
比例是非常重要的。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
^4D4DFF10 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF100 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Jellopies^000000, and
^4D4DFF5 Empty Bottles^000000.

on to the hard part.

^4D4DFF50 果冻派^000000，以及
^4D4DFF5 空瓶^000000。
然后我们就可以
进入困难的部分了。

scripts.text:

Oh, great! You brought
everything! Now... It's
time for you to do the,
um, hard part.
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
哦，太棒了！你
都带来了！现在...
该由你来完成那个，
嗯，困难的部分了。

Silk Sand Camel farm
owner in town that I sent
you, and show him the
ingredients that you've
gathered for me so far.

请告诉城镇里
丝沙骆驼农场的
主人，是我派你来的，
并让他看看你
为我收集到的
那些原料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
Why would I want
to see the guy that
takes care of Silk Sand
Camels? What does he
have to do with soap?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
我为什么要去见
那个照顾丝沙骆驼
的人？他和肥皂
有什么关系？

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]

Just go visit Mr. Saraman,
the Camel Farm owner.
I can't wait for you that long,
so please come back here
as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:

先别管那么多...
去拜访一下骆驼农场
的主人，萨拉曼先生。
我可等不了那么久，
所以请尽快回来。

[{0}]

him if I really need you
to make the soap...

萨拉曼先生...？
好吧，如果我真的
需要你制作肥皂，

to stimulate a camel's
appetite. Now I need to
feed the camel so that I can
get the soap ingredients and
5 lumps of camel dung.
scripts.translation:

我已经备齐了
刺激骆驼食欲的东西。
现在我需要喂骆驼，
这样才能拿到肥皂原料

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right now, my time
would be better spent
looking for the Silk Sand
Camel for the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在，我的时间
最好用来寻找
丝绸沙骆驼，
以获取原料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd better find Mr. Saraman's
lost camel, feed it camel
appetite stimulants, and
then get the soap ingredient
and 5 lumps of camel dung
if I want to free Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得找到萨拉曼先生
丢失的骆驼，喂它
骆驼开胃剂，
然后拿到肥皂原料
和5块骆驼粪便，
这样才能解救卡迪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I found the
camel. Now I need to get
all the soap ingredients.
The sooner I do that, the
sooner I can help Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我找到了
骆驼。现在我需要
集齐所有的肥皂原料。
越快完成，
我就能越快帮到卡迪。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou already found the
camel, so you need to collect
the soap ingredients if you
want to free Curdie.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF既然你已经找到了骆驼，
那么如果你真想
解开柯迪的脚炼，
就需要收集肥皂原料。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I managed to get the soap
ingredients: 5 of those
camel dung lumps. I should
head back to Mr. Saraman to
tell him where his camel is,
and then go to Ms. Ivory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了肥皂原料：
5块骆驼粪便。
我应该回去告诉萨拉曼
他的骆驼在哪里，
然后再去找艾芙丽女士。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Hm, did Soony give you
any trouble? I'm guessing
that's why it's been taking
you so long to get all that
camel dung over here.
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
嗯，苏尼有没有
给你添麻烦？我猜
这就是你花了这么长时间
才把那些骆驼粪便
弄过来的原因。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It was a pretty big
hassle... But hopefully,
this will all be worth it.
Anyway, take this camel
dung. I don't want to
handle it for much longer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
确实挺麻烦的...
但希望这一切
都是值得的。
总之，拿着这些骆驼粪便吧。
我不想再碰它太久了。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Yes, I can understand that.
Even though it's in bottles,
it's pretty gross that these
bottles are still warm...
Anyway, we're good to go.
Let me make you some soap~
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
是的，我能理解。
虽然装在瓶子里，
但这些瓶子还是温的...
真恶心。总之，
我们可以开始了。
让我为你制作肥皂~

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
You spent a lot of
time and energy to get
these, so I won't charge
you for my service. Besides,
you brought enough materials
that I'll have some left over.
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
你花了大量的
时间和精力来收集
这些，所以我不收
你的服务费。况且，
你带来的材料足够多，
我还会剩下一些。

scripts.text:
^3355FFMs. Ivory put on a pair
of long gloves, and mixed
the ingredients. She then
placed them in a clean bottle.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF艾沃里女士戴上了一双
长手套，混合了原料。

装进了一个干净的瓶子里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Here's your soap! After
you pour the soap into
something, don't forget
to put it into a larger bottle
after about twenty seconds.
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
这是你的肥皂！当你
把肥皂倒进什么东西里后，
别忘了在大约二十秒后
把它放进一个更大的瓶子里。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
And um... Don't let
anyone else know what
I use to make this soap.
People won't buy it if they
knew they were washing their
faces with... You know...
scripts.translation:
[有机皂师 艾沃里]
还有...不要告诉
任何人我用来制作
这种肥皂的原料。
如果他们知道自己在用...
你知道的...来洗脸，
他们就不会买了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry, I won't
tell anyone. Thanks
for making the soap!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别担心，我不会
告诉任何人。谢谢
你制作的肥皂！

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow that you have the
Silk Sand Camel Soap.
you should bring it
to Mr. Lockenlock.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF既然你已经拿到了

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
^333333*Phew!*^000000 It's been
a long day. I think
I'll close up shop now~
scripts.translation:

^333333*呼！*^000000 真是
漫长的一天。我想
我要打烊了~

something? I'm still
setting up shop now
so I'm not really ready
to sell anything yet.
scripts.translation:
[美丽的女士]
嗯？你需要
什么吗？我还在
布置店铺，
所以还没准备好
开始营业。

scripts.translation:

ingredients? She said
I had to come to you if

艾沃里女士派我

some fresh camel dung.

千真万确，

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Yeah, those ingredients
you brought me? They're for
making soap alright. ^FF0000That's
what we feed the camels^000000 so
that they make a whole lotta
dung. Dung to make soap.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
没错，你带来的那些原料？
确实是用来做肥皂的。^FF0000那是
我们喂骆驼吃的^000000，
这样它们就能产生大量的
粪便。用粪便来做肥皂。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Oh, don't worry. Camel
dung is sterile, completely
safe. In fact, it smells nice,
has medicinal properties, and
it's considered a delicacy
in certain countries.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
哦，别担心。骆驼
粪便是无菌的，完全
安全。事实上，它闻起来
很香，具有药用价值，
在某些国家甚至被视为
美味佳肴。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Sadly, Silk Sand Camels
are almost extinct, so I only
have one on this farm. That's
why we have a special contract with Ms. Ivory to make her soap.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
不幸的是，丝沙骆驼
几乎灭绝了，所以我农场里
只有一只。这就是为什么
我们与艾沃里女士有特别
契约，让她制作肥皂。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Say... I wasn't expecting
her to send a deliveryman
until tomorrow. Why are
you here so early anyway?
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
话说... 我没想到
她会派送货员
明天才来。你
为什么这么早来？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, this is kind
of an emergency. You see,
I need the soap to make a
key mold because I lost--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，这有点
紧急。你看，
我需要肥皂来制作
钥匙模具，因为我丢了--

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Never mind, never mind.
I'm sorry I asked! So this
is a personal favor for you,
huh? Well, there's a bit of
a problem that we need to
solve first. Listen up...
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
算了，算了。
抱歉我问了！所以
这是你的私人委托，
对吧？嗯，有个小问题
我们需要先解决。听好了...

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
We can only get camel
dung after a camel eats,
right? Well, my camel isn't
used to eating so late in the
day. Even if we put food in
front of her, she won't eat it.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
骆驼只有吃了东西
才能产生粪便，
对吧？嗯，我的骆驼
不习惯这么晚进食。
即使我们把食物放在
她面前，她也不会吃。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? Isn't there
something we can do?
I mean, I'm talking about
a life or death matter!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？难道没有
什么办法吗？
我是说，这可是
生死攸关的大事！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
*Sigh* ...This isn't good... Okay then, let's do this.
Sometimes I make an appetite stimulant for the camel
when she's sick and wouldn't eat anything.
We can try feeding her the stimulant, and make it poop.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
*叹气* ...这不好办... 好吧，那就这样吧。
有时候骆驼生病不吃东西时，我会给她做开胃剂。
我们可以试着喂她开胃剂，让她排便。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Well, we can't forcefeed
her, but we can get her to
munch a bit on some appetite
stimulant. I usually use that
if she's sick, but if you say
that this is an emergency...
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
嗯，我们不能强行喂食，
但我们可以让她
吃点开胃剂。我通常
在她生病时用这个，
但如果你说这是紧急情况...

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Alright, I guess we
can try it. But I want you
to bring me the ingredients.
Get me... Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
好吧，我想我们
可以试试。但我要你
带原料来。给我... 让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
^4D4DFF1 Unripe Apple^000000,
^4D4DFF5 Monster's Feed^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Empty Bottle^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
^4D4DFF1 青苹果^000000，
^4D4DFF5 魔物饲料^000000，
^4D4DFF1 空瓶^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1 黄色药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Oh good, you're back.
Did you bring everything?
Here, I need to mix it all
together first before you
can feed it to my camel.
Just a minute now...
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
太好了，你回来了。
东西都带齐了吗？
这里，我得先把它们混合在一起，
然后你才能喂给我的骆驼。
请稍等片刻...

scripts.text:
^3355FFSaraman mixed all
of the ingredients,
and gingerly poured
them into a bottle.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF萨拉曼将所有材料混合，
小心翼翼地倒进了瓶子里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Alright, now bring
this to the camels over
there. Only my Silk Sand
Camel will know to eat it,
so she'll come after you.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
好了，现在把这个
带给那边的骆驼。
只有我的丝沙骆驼
会知道去吃它，
所以她会跟着你走的。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Once she nibbles this
appetite stimulant, she'll
eat her feed like crazy.
Then the dung will flow
like a faucet. Come on,
why don't you give it a try?
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
一旦她尝了这开胃剂，
她就会疯狂地吃饲料。
然后粪便就会像水龙头一样流出来。
来吧，
何不试试看？

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Oh, right. You should
be able to get 5 lumps
of camel dung with those
ingredients. That's a good
amount to collect since that's
what Ms. Ivory usually orders.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
哦，对了。用那些材料
你应该能收集到5块骆驼粪便。
这是一个不错的数量，
因为艾芙丽小姐通常订购的就是这个量。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. Saraman, none
of the camels will eat
this appetite stimulant...
Am I doing something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
萨拉曼先生，
没有一只骆驼愿意吃
这开胃剂...
我是不是做错了什么？

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Oh, yes, well...
One of my workers
just came by, and told me
that my Silk Sand Camel
disappeared somewhere...
This is terrible news!
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
哦，是的，嗯...
我的一个工人刚来过，
告诉我我的丝沙骆驼
不知跑到哪里去了...
这真是糟糕透顶的消息！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
My precious Silk Sand
Camel... It's my biggest
business investment! I'm
ruined without it! Please...
I'll reward you if you can
find my camel for me!
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
我珍贵的丝沙骆驼...
这是我最大的商业投资！
没有它我就完了！拜托...
如果你能帮我找到骆驼，
我会重重感谢你的！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Damn it! My stupid worker
forgot to tie her up, so
she ended up running away!
Ugh! Please help me find her!
Without her, you won't be able
to get your special camel dung.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
该死！我那愚蠢的工人
忘了把她拴住，
结果她跑掉了！
唉！请帮帮我找到她！
没有她，你就拿不到
那种特殊的骆驼粪便了。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Wait, don't panic...
It'll all be alright.
This camel moves very slowly
so she shouldn't be far from
here. Please find my camel
Soony as soon as you can!
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
等等，别慌...
一切都会好起来的。
这只骆驼移动得很慢，
所以她应该离这里不远。
请尽快帮我找到我的
索妮！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Soony! Soony...!
Wh-where are you?!
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
索妮！索妮...
你...你在哪里？！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Please, help me find
my Soony, my Silk Sand
Camel. You won't be able to
make your soap without her!
And my business is really
dependent on my Soony!
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
拜托，帮我找到
我的索妮，我的丝沙骆驼。
没有她，你就做不出
你想要的肥皂了！
而且我的生意
真的很依赖我的索妮！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I found the
camel. Now I need to get
all the soap ingredients.
The sooner I do that, the
sooner I can help Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我找到了
骆驼。现在我需要
集齐所有的肥皂原料。
越快完成，
我就能越快帮到卡迪。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou already found the
camel, so you need to collect
the soap ingredients if you
want to free Curdie.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF既然你已经找到了骆驼，
那么如果你真想
解开柯迪的脚炼，
就需要收集肥皂原料。^000000

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Oh, it's you!
Did you find my
Soony? Where is she?
What happened to her?
Oh God, I don't know what
I'll do without that camel!
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
哦，是你！
你找到我的索妮了吗？
她在哪里？
她怎么了？
天哪，我不知道
没有那只骆驼我该怎么办！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry, Mr. Saraman,
I found Soony at the outskirts
of town. She hurt her leg so
I think it'd be a good idea if
you sent some people to
help bring her back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别担心，萨拉曼先生，
我在城镇边缘找到了索妮。
她伤了腿，所以我觉得
最好派些人
去帮她回来。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Thank god! Thank you, thank you so much!
I'll send my workers over there immediately.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
谢天谢地！谢谢你，太感谢了！
我会立刻派我的工人过去。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Thank goodness, you have
no idea how valuable that
camel is! I'll send some of
my men to bring her home
immediately! Thank you,
you just saved my business!
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
谢天谢地，你不知道
那只骆驼有多珍贵！
我会立刻派我的人
把她带回来！谢谢你，
你救了我的生意！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Here, I want you to
have this. Consider it
a little thank you gift for
what you've done for me.
Good luck with getting
that soap you want made.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
拿着，我想让你
收下这个。就当是
对你为我所做之事的
小小感谢礼物。
祝你在制作
那种肥皂时好运。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
Shouldn't I be going
to see Ms. Ivory now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我想想...
我现在应该
去找艾芙丽小姐吗？

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Thank you for finding my
precious Silk Sand Camel
Soony. Come again sometime,
and maybe we can special my
special camel yogurt together.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼农场主 萨拉曼]
谢谢你找到了我珍贵的
丝沙骆驼索妮。
改天再来，
也许我们可以一起
尝尝我的特制骆驼酸奶。

scripts.text:
[Saraman]
Zzz... Zzz~
Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[萨拉曼]
呼... 呼~
呼...

scripts.text:
^3355FFWatching this man
snore also makes you
want to take a snooze.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看着这个男人打呼噜，
你也想打个盹了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe camel sniffed the
appetite stimulant, but
brusquely turned its
nose away from it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF骆驼嗅了嗅开胃剂，
但立刻把鼻子扭开了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe camel sniffed the
appetite stimulant, but
brusquely turned its
nose away from it.
This probably isn't the
camel you're looking for.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF骆驼嗅了嗅开胃剂，
但立刻把鼻子扭开了。
这恐怕不是你找的那只骆驼。^000000

scripts.text:
[Camel]
*Neigh* ~
*Chew Chew*
scripts.translation:
[骆驼]
*嘶嘶* ~
*咀嚼咀嚼*

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis camel's leg is
wounded. Although it
seems hurt, its nostrils
flared as soon as it saw
the camel appetite stimulant,
and it smacked its lips.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这只骆驼的腿受了伤。
虽然看起来很痛苦，
但一看到骆驼开胃剂，
它的鼻孔就张大了，
还咂了咂嘴。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe camel started nibbling
the stimulant, but its eating
became quicker as it ate
more of the feed until it
was completely consumed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF骆驼开始啃食开胃剂，
随着吃得越来越多，
它的进食速度也越来越快，
直到完全被吃光。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This must be the
Silk Sand Camel...
I guess all I need to
do is collect some of
that precious camel dung.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这应该就是丝沙骆驼了...
看来我只需要
收集一些珍贵的骆驼粪便。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe camel can smell
that you have food for
it, and started salivating.
You may as well just feed it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF骆驼闻到了你身上
有它的食物，开始流口水了。
你不妨直接喂给它。^000000

scripts.text:
[Silk Sand Camel]
^333333*Chew Chew~*^000000
^333333*Smacks lips*^000000

^3355FFThe camel ate everything,
but it doesn't seem like
it'll go through any bowel
movements anytime soon.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF骆驼把东西全吃光了，
但看起来短时间内
它不会排便。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe camel grimaced
as if it were suffering
from a stomachache...
And... Out pops 2 Sweet
Potatoes. They're probably
safe to eat... Hopefully.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF骆驼痛苦地皱起了脸，
好像肚子疼...
然后... 吐出了2个红薯。
它们应该是可以吃的...
希望如此。^000000

scripts.text:
[Silk Sand Camel]
^333333*Chew Chew~*^000000
^333333*Smacks lips*^000000

^3355FFThe camel grimaced
as if it were suffering
from a stomachache...
Huzzah! You got a lump
of steaming camel dung!
This is cause for celebration!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF骆驼痛苦地皱起了脸，
好像肚子疼...
万岁！你得到了一坨
热气腾腾的骆驼粪便！
这值得庆祝！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
In my hands...
I am holding
5 lumps of camel dung.
This is my finest moment.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在我手中...
我握着5坨骆驼粪便。
这是我人生中最辉煌的时刻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now all I need is
just 4 more lumps
of this nasty old dung.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在我只需要
再收集4坨
这恶心的粪便了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Awesome! I got
2 glorious camel dung
lumps! Only 3 more to go!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太棒了！我得到了
2坨光荣的骆驼粪便！
还差3坨！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes! Now I have
3 camel dung lumps.
Just 2 more... I'm more
than halfway done!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的！现在我有了
3坨骆驼粪便。
还差2坨... 我已经
完成一半多了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
4 lumps of camel dung...
Heh heh! This is going
better than I thought!
Only 1 more to go!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
4坨骆驼粪便...
嘿嘿！这比我想象的
还要顺利！
只差最后1坨了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Never, in all my years
of adventuring, saving the
oppressed, protecting the
innocent, did I dare dream
that I'd accomplish such
a magnificent feat.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在我多年的冒险生涯中，
拯救受压迫者，保护无辜者，
我从未敢梦想过
能完成如此伟大的壮举。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am so happy--nay--
^4D4DFFproud^000000 that my strength, my
valor, and my determination
was up to this task. May the
annals of history never forget
this day! Long live {1}!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我太高兴了——不——
^4D4DFF自豪^000000，我的力量、
我的勇气，以及我的提升斗志
都经受住了这项任务的考验。
愿史册永远铭记这一天！
{1}万岁！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's time for you to
return to Mr. Saraman.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF是时候回去
找萨拉曼先生了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Silk Sand Camel]
^333333*Chew Chew~*^000000
^333333*Smacks lips*^000000

^3355FFThe camel grimaced
as if it were suffering
from a stomachache...
And... Out pops a Sweet
Potato. It's probably
safe to eat... Maybe.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF骆驼痛苦地皱起了眉头，
好像肚子疼一样...
然后...吐出了一颗红薯。
应该...大概可以吃吧。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to feed this camel if
I ever want to get any dung
from it. Let's see, Mr. Saraman
mentioned that the items I got

饲料已经用完了吗？

find a locksmith?

[{0}]
打扰一下，你知道

Mr. Lockenlock is a famous
locksmith, and he makes almost
all the keys and locks in Veins
and even in Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[托比]
当然知道！
洛肯洛克先生是著名的锁匠，
伯仁斯甚至拉赫的
大部分钥匙和锁都是他做的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. Lockenlock, eh?
So where can I find him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
洛肯洛克先生，是吗？
那我能在哪里找到他呢？

scripts.text:
[Toby]
Oh, he's always sitting
somewhere in the market
street. He drinks a lot,
though, so he doesn't really
work when he's hung over.
scripts.translation:
[托比]
哦，他总是坐在
市场街上的某个地方。
不过他酒量很差，
宿醉的时候基本不干活。

scripts.text:
[Toby]
Ah, but you know what'll
shock him back to sobriety?
A Yellow Potion! It never
fails with that guy!
scripts.translation:
[托比]
啊，不过你知道什么
能让他瞬间清醒吗？
黄色药水！对他从来没失过手！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.
Thanks for
the advice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了。
谢谢你的建议。

scripts.text:
[Toby]
You're so very
welcome! It's just...
After all these years...
I'm finally useful to someone!
scripts.translation:
[托比]
不客气！只是...
这么多年过去了...
我终于对别人有用处了！

[{0}]
不用了，谢谢。

You don't...
^333333*Sob*^000000 You don't
need me at all?
scripts.translation:

你不需要...

High Priest Vildt isn't

scripts.translation:

神官 维尔德现在不在。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This guy's not going to
let me pass. Let's see...
Is there some way I could
get him to leave? What, or
even ^FF0000who^000000, could distract him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这家伙不让我过去。让我想想...
有没有什么办法能让他离开？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait a second...
Of course! I should
talk to him about...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
当然！我应该跟他聊聊...

Wait a second...
Of course! I should

[{0}]
What the...?
Where did I think of that?
That doesn't make any sense...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这...？
我怎么会想到这个？
这完全说不通...

scripts.text:
[{0}]

guy must be Karlum, the guy

Hmm... I know what I'll say...

没错！我刚才跟拉米尔聊过。
如果她说的是真的，那这家伙一定是卡鲁姆，

嗯...我知道该说什么了...

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333*咳*^000000 打扰一下，
你是卡鲁姆吗？
我有话要转告你。

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
A message for me?
Is that why you're still
loitering around? Well,
spit it out. I can't waste
too much time on the job...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 卡鲁姆]
给我留话？
这就是你一直在这里闲逛的原因吗？
快说吧。我不能在岗位上浪费太多时间...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know ^3131FFLamir^000000, right?

[Guard Karlum]
Lamir? Oh... My.
Oh no! Did something
bad happen to her?
Quick, tell me!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 卡鲁姆]
拉米尔？噢...
噢不！她出什么事了吗？
快告诉我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, nothing like that.
She just told me that she
had something important to
tell you, and that you had to
come see her when you're free.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，没出什么事。
她只是告诉我，她有一件重要的事要告诉你，
让你有空的时候务必去见她。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I tried to ask her
more, but she just kept
blushing and turning away.
Is there something going
on between you too?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想多问点，但她只是一直脸红并转过头去。
你们之间是不是也有什么？

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
...I don't believe it.
Finally. After all these
years. She feels the same
way I feel for her! My midnight
serenade a few days ago
must've touched her heart.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 卡鲁姆]
...我不信。
终于。这么多年了。
她对我的感觉和我对她的一样！
几天前我午夜的即兴演奏一定打动了她的心。

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
Screw this stupid job!
I've made my choice, and
I choose true love! I can't
keep Lamir waiting any longer!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 卡鲁姆]
去死吧这破工作！
我已经做出了选择，我选择了真爱！
我不能让拉米尔再等下去了！

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
Hey! Lamir told me that
she didn't want to see
me at all! What's your
game, huh? Do you think
I'm that easy to trick?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 卡鲁姆]
嘿！拉米尔告诉我她根本不想见我！
你在玩什么把戏，嗯？你以为我这么好骗吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? Is that what
happened? I could've
sworn th--Oooh. I get it now.
She must be playing hard to
get. That must mean that
she's reeeeally into you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？是这样吗？我明明记得她--噢。我明白了。
她一定是在欲擒故纵。这意味着她真的很喜欢你。

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
Ah! That makes perfect
sense! No wonder she treated
me that way! Hahaha! I should
have figured it out sooner!
Well then, I should go see
her and play hard to get too!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 卡鲁姆]
啊！这就说得通了！难怪她那样对我！
哈哈！我早该想到的！
那么，我也应该去见她，也欲擒故纵一下！

wish to see him.
scripts.translation:

神官 维尔德现在不在。

[Guard Krodger]
Who's there?!

[卫兵 克罗杰]
谁在那里？！

[{0}]
A lot of loving care
was put into arranging
these flowers.. I can't
bear to disturb their beauty.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这些花显然是经过精心布置的...

^333333*Sigh*^000000 High Priest Vildt

^333333*叹气*^000000 神官维尔德
吃完后剩下了那么多食物。

scripts.text:

to threaten that she'd force
me to marry Karlum if I didn't
finish all my food when I was
a kid. I learned never to
leave any leftovers that way~
scripts.translation:
[拉米尔]
你知道吗，我母亲以前
总是威胁我，如果我不把

绝不剩饭~

scripts.text: Who's Karlum?

scripts.text:

Karlum? Oh, he's been
chasing me ever since we
were kids, declaring his
love and all that. Even
after we grew up, he's still
stubborn about that point.
scripts.translation:
[拉米尔]
卡鲁姆？哦，他从我们
小时候起就一直在追我，
还总是向我表白什么的。
即使我们长大了，
他在这点上依然很固执。

scripts.text:
[Lamir]
Ugh! Even today, he
still gets on my nerves!
I mean, it's great that he's
a guard at High Priest Vildt's
office, but come on! Why can't
he bother another girl?
scripts.translation:
[拉米尔]
真是的！直到今天，
他依然让我很烦！
虽然他是神官维尔德
办公室的卫兵，这很好，
但拜托！他为什么不能
去纠缠别的女孩呢？

scripts.text:
[Guard Krodger]
What's with this vase?
They always send me out
here to clean up this mess!
I mean, it happens so often,
I don't think it's accidental.
You think it's vandals?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵 克罗杰]
这个花瓶是怎么回事？
他们总是派我出来
清理这种烂摊子！
而且发生得太频繁了，
我觉得这不是意外。
你觉得是有人故意破坏吗？

检查一下这些文件。

[{0}]

厚报告，然后关上了抽屉。^000000

[{0}]
Forget it.
I didn't get permission
to look through these files.

[{0}]
算了。
我没有权限查看这些文件。

[{0}]
Oh! Here's another
copy of that report
I wanted! Pretty lucky~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢！这里还有另一份
我想要的那份报告！
运气真好~

ladder to sneak out of

I'd get caught if I just

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，我可以用这个梯子
偷偷溜出去！
既然我是偷偷进来的，
要是直接经过卫兵那里
肯定会被抓住...

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定暂时不爬梯子。^000000

it's been abandoned for
a while: the floor is thickly

pieces of discarded paper.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这栋房子看起来
已经废弃很久了：

scripts.text:
^3355FFOne particular piece

scripts.translation:

''^333333定期地质勘探已推迟
超过一周。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Although the sender's
name isn't on this letter,
I can guess who wrote it. 
Speaking of which...
Where's the geologist?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
虽然这封信上没有署名，

话说回来...
地质学家在哪里？

scripts.text:

The small office on the

shop is occupied by a
geologist. At least, he's
supposed to be one...

这家武器店二楼的小办公室
住着一位地质学家。

scripts.text:

all he does is drink and
flirt with skanky women
all day. I thought scholars
are supposed to read and study
and discover things, you know?
scripts.translation:
[镇民]
这家伙可能是个骗子：
整天就知道喝酒，
还跟那些不正经的女人调情。
我以为学者应该是
读书、研究、发现新事物的，不是吗？

scripts.text:

So... ^333333*Urp*^000000
So then I said...

[Drunken Man]
''^3131FFHey, buddy! A man
uses his back to talk,
not his fists! You wanna
piece of me? Bring it on!^000000''
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
''^3131FF嘿，伙计！
男人是靠背说话，
不是靠拳头！
想尝尝我的厉害？来啊！^000000''

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Then he got all
scared, and ran away!
Hahahaha! Guess I look
pretty tough, don't I?
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
然后他就吓得
屁滚尿流地跑了！
哈哈哈！看来我
挺厉害的，对吧？

scripts.text:

Oh, my God!
You're so cool~!
scripts.translation:
[女士们]
天哪！
你好酷~！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Well... Anyone would
have done it. I was just
being a gentleman.

我已经完成了足够的测量。
现在应该把这份报告
提交给地质考察营地了~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis patch of ground
emits an intense heat
that stings your face.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这片地面
散发出强烈的热量，
刺痛了你的脸。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Only authorized
personnel can enter this
area. Identify yourself!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
只有授权人员
才能进入该区域。
请表明你的身份！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm a research student working
under Director Gio for the
Veins Geological Research
Institute. Would you please
stamp this temperature
report for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是伯仁斯地质研究所
吉奥总监的研究助理。
麻烦您在这份温度报告上
盖个章好吗？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Oh, I see. Well, I'm
not the one that stamps
reports. Go inside and
ask Sahedi to help you.
He's at the airship just
south of the train station.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
哦，我明白了。
不过盖章的人不是我。
请进去找萨赫迪帮忙。
他在火车站南边的飞空艇上。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Oh, you're that student
from the institute. I don't
think we're expecting
any reports soon.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
哦，你是研究所的那个学生。
我想我们最近
并没有收到报告的计划。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, we just found out
that the instruments we
used were faulty, so we
had to revise our report.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我们刚发现
之前使用的仪器有故障，
所以不得不重新修订报告。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Your tools were broken
the first time? Okay, okay,
I can understand that.
Alright, you can pass.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
你的工具第一次就坏了？
好吧，好吧，
我能理解。
那么，你可以通过了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Who are you?!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
你是谁？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
I'm sorry, but I don't
think I know you. Only
authorized personnel is
allowed in this area, so
if you don't have any
reason to be here...
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
抱歉，我不认识你。
只有授权人员
才能进入该区域，
如果你没有正当理由在这里...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm a research student working
under Director Gio for the
Veins Geological Research
Institute. Would you please
stamp this temperature
report for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是伯仁斯地质研究所
吉奥总监的研究助理。
麻烦您在这份温度报告上
盖个章好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, Gio is sick right
now, so that's why he
had me fill out this report
form and submit it for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，吉奥现在生病了，
所以他让我填写这份报告
并替他提交。

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Ah, so that's why his
report's late this time.
I'm sorry to hear that.
And here I thought he was
just wasting his time on
women and alcohol...
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
啊，原来是他这次报告迟交的原因。
听到这个消息我很遗憾。
我还以为他只是在
浪费时间在女人和酒精上...

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Oh God! Why is the
temperature so high?!
We've had a few reports
like this in the past, but...
Is this... How bad is this?
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
天哪！为什么
温度这么高？！
过去我们也收到过
类似的报告，但是...
这是...情况有多严重？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Oh, no!
Yikes! I guess if it's
higher than normal...
It might be bad?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...哦，不！
天哪！我想如果
比正常值高...
可能会很糟糕？

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
What should I do?
Should I activate
the alarm? I don't...
I don't wanna die!
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
我该怎么办？
应该启动警报吗？
我...我不想死！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You might want to calm
down first. I'll take a look
around the camp, so please
don't say anything that will
make anyone else panic for now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你可能需要先冷静下来。
我会去营地周围查看一下，
所以请暂时不要说任何
会让其他人恐慌的话。

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Okay...
Please go ahead, and
see if this camp will be
safe from any disaster.
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
好的...
请去吧，
看看这个营地是否能
安全地避开任何灾难。

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
So, are we in any
danger? Does it look
like this volcano will
erupt anytime soon?
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
那么，我们有危险吗？
看起来这座火山
会随时喷发吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I'm not finished
investigating yet. Would
you please wait a bit longer?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我还没调查完。
请再稍等一下好吗？

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Sure, sure. Just make
sure that you do a real
thorough check of everything
in the volcano for me, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
当然，当然。只是请确保
你彻底检查火山里的
每一个角落，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
So, are we in any
danger? Does it look
like this volcano will
erupt anytime soon?
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
那么，我们有危险吗？
看起来这座火山
会随时喷发吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess I can't hide it
from you... The recent
activity of this volcano
has recently been fairly...
disconcerting.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想...瞒不住你了...最近这座火山
的活动情况相当...令人不安。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait... You should take
advantage of this situation.
This could be your chance to
intervene in the conflict
between two contries!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等...你应该利用这个情况。
这可能是你介入两国冲突的机会！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou might not be able
to stop their war, but
maybe you can distract
them with the threat
of natural disaster...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你可能无法阻止他们的战争，
但也许你可以用自然灾害的威胁
来分散他们的注意力...^000000

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Huh? Are you serious?
Thor Volcano's gonna
erupt?! We-we have to
get the hell out of here!
It'll be a disaster, just
like it happened in the past!
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
什么？你是认真的吗？
索尔火山要喷发？！
我们...我们必须赶紧离开这里！
这会是一场灾难，就像过去发生过的那样！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I agree. There's
a good chance of an...
explosion that'll cause
a lot of collateral damage.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我同意。发生...爆炸的可能性很大，
那会造成大量的附带损害。

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
What are our chances?
How much time do we
have to evacuate?
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
我们的胜算有多大？
我们有多少时间撤离？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Uh...
According to my data...
Analysis... There's a 75%
chance of eruption within
the next thirty days.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...呃...
根据我的数据...
分析...未来三十天内
有75%的喷发概率。

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
What?! We must report
this to the high priest
immediately! Aitra!
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
什么？！我们必须立即
向神官报告这件事！艾特拉！

scripts.text:
[Aitra]
Yes, sir!
scripts.translation:
[艾特拉]
是，长官！

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
This is an emergency.
Bring this message to
the high priest as soon
as possible. And don't
forget to pack all your
things before you leave.
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
这是紧急情况。
请尽快把这条消息
带给神官。还有，
离开前别忘了收拾好你的东西。

scripts.text:
[Aitra]
Huh?
 ...Yes, sir.
scripts.translation:
[艾特拉]
什么？
...是，长官。

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Oh, this is a nightmare...
Will you please take your
report to your director, Gio?
Hopefully he'll have some
advice for what we can
do about this disaster...
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
哦，这真是场噩梦...
乔，请你把报告
带给你的总监好吗？
希望他能给我们一些
应对这场灾难的建议...

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Argh, I'm so busy!
scripts.translation:
[萨赫迪]
啊，我太忙了！

scripts.text:
[????]
You...!
What are you doing
just standing around?!
Aren't you supposed to
be transporting cargo? 
Attention to orders!
scripts.translation:
[????]
你...！
你站在那里干什么？！
你不应该去运送货物吗？
服从命令！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you talking to me?
No, I'm from the Veins Geo--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在跟我说话吗？
不，我是来自伯仁斯地理...

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Look at you. You don't
even have your uniform
yet. Still a rookie, eh?
Looks like I'll have to
personally train you as
one of our holy knights!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
看看你。你连制服
都还没穿呢。还是个新兵，是吧？
看来我得亲自训练你，
让你成为我们神圣骑士的一员！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But I'm not--

[Colonel Vito]
You should be honored to
have the rare opportunity
to be trained by me, the
great Colonel Vito. I'll mold
you into a true warrior for
Freya! Now follow me!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
你应该感到荣幸，
能有机会接受我，伟大的上校维托的训练。
我会把你塑造成
为芙蕾雅而战的真正战士！
现在跟我来！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
What are you still
doing standing there?
Don't slack off! Come!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
你还站在那里干什么？
别偷懒！跟上！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
I am Colonel Vito,
and I'm in charge of
the Arunafeltz camp
here in Thor Volcano.
What's your name, soldier?
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
我是上校维托，
负责管理索尔火山这里的
阿鲁纳菲兹营地。
你的名字是什么，士兵？

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Hmpf! That's a weakling's
name! I can tell that your
mind and body are too weak!
That won't do. How will you
be worthy of serving the
beautiful, graceful Freya?
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
哼！那是弱者的名字！
我看得出你的身心都太虚弱了！
这可不行。你这样怎么配得上
侍奉美丽优雅的女神芙蕾雅？

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
You need more training.
Take a break first, and
prepare yourself. We will
begin as soon as you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
你需要更多的训练。
先休息一下，做好准备。
等你准备好了，我们就开始。

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
First, we need to take
care of that weak mind
of yours. This first
training exercise will
be verbal based.
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
首先，我们需要处理一下
你那软弱的心灵。
这第一个训练科目
将以口头问答为主。

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Question one!
Who do we fight for?
Who do we live for?
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
问题一！
我们为谁而战？
我们为谁而活？

scripts.text: Odin
scripts.translation: 奥丁

scripts.text: Freya
scripts.translation: 芙蕾雅

scripts.text: Thor
scripts.translation: 索尔

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
You idiot!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
你这个蠢货！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Right! Freya is not only
a goddess of love, but she's
also a goddess of war.
We are on a sacred mission
to recover the pieces of
Ymir's Heart for her sake.
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
没错！芙蕾雅不仅是爱之神，
也是战争女神。
我们肩负着神圣的使命，
为了她而夺回伊米尔之心的碎片。

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Freya was greatly wounded
in the war among gods,
humans, and demons.
Odin, the leader of the
gods, tried to help her, but
even his power wasn't enough.
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
芙蕾雅在神、人与恶魔的
战争中受了重伤。
众神之首奥丁试图帮助她，
但即使他的力量也不够。

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Odin did advise her to
obtain Ymir's Heart, as
it would fully recover her
powers. That is why we are
preparing for war: we must
obtain Ymir's Heart for Freya!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
奥丁曾建议她获取伊米尔之心，
因为那能让她完全恢复力量。
这就是我们备战的原因：
我们必须为芙蕾雅夺回伊米尔之心！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
DO YOU UNDERSTAND?!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
你听懂了吗？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, sir!

[Colonel Vito]
Now, there's a country
called the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom that's full of fools.
Their ancestors branded us
as heretics and drove us
to this deserted land.
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
现在，有一个叫卢恩·米德加兹
王国的地方，那里全是傻瓜。
他们的祖先将我们定为异端，
并将我们驱逐到这片荒凉之地。

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
We cannot forgive how they
denied us our freedom to
worship Freya. Our people
will have revenge on them.
Mark my word, soldier.
Now, repeat after me.
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
我们无法原谅他们剥夺我们
崇拜芙蕾雅的自由。
我们要向他们复仇。
记住我的话，士兵。
现在，跟着我念。

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
I, {0},
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
我，{0}，

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
^FF0000as a devoted servant
of Goddess Freya
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
^FF0000作为女神芙蕾雅
虔诚的仆人

scripts.text:
[{0}]
as a devoted servant
of Goddess Freya, the
patron saint of the
great Arunafeltz,^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
作为女神芙蕾雅，
伟大阿鲁纳菲兹的守护神，
虔诚的仆人，^000000

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Wrong! Try again!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
错了！再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
^FF0000I pledge my honor to
overthrow our mortal enemy
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
^FF0000我宣誓以荣誉
推翻我们的宿敌

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I pledge my honor to
overthrow our mortal enemy,
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我宣誓以荣誉
推翻我们的宿敌，
卢恩·米德加兹王国。

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Wrong! Try again!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
错了！再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
^FF0000I will show no mercy^000000
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
^FF0000我绝不心慈手软^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will show no mercy.
Nothing will stay my hand.^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我绝不心慈手软。
没有任何东西能阻挡我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Wrong! Try again!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
错了！再试一次！

^FF0000I shall devote

scripts.text:

I shall devote my
entire life to the
full recovery of
Goddess Freya.^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我将奉献我的一生，
为了女神芙蕾雅
完全恢复神威。^000000

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Wrong! Try again!
scripts.translation:

错了！再试一次！

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

错了！再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Good. Now you know the
kind of attitude that you
must have as a holy warrior
in Freya's service. That
is all for the first exercise,
but there's one more left.
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
很好。现在你知道作为侍奉芙蕾雅的女神战士，
必须具备怎样的态度了。
第一项训练到此结束，
但还有一项。

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Before we actually do
the 2nd training exercise,
I have a duty to assign to
you. Find the huge pipe zone
to the north of this building
and find any broken machines.
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
在进行第二项训练之前，
我有一项任务要交给你。
去这栋建筑北边的大型管道区域，
寻找任何损坏的机器。

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Inspect the machines
in the pipe zone to the
north of this building.
Don't dawdle: move out!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
检查这栋建筑北边管道区域的机器。
别磨蹭：出发！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Good work. Remember
that your first priority is to
check the control panel.
It needs to be regularly
inspected since it controls
the camp's energy resources.
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
干得好。记住，
你的首要任务是检查控制面板。
因为它控制着营地的能量资源，
所以需要定期检修。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, sir!

[Colonel Vito]
Now it's time for the
second training exercise
which will strengthen your
body. See the dummy in
front of you? Practice by
chopping it 10 times. Go!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
现在是第二项训练的时间，
这将增强你的体魄。
看到前面的假人了吗？
练习砍它10次。开始！

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，长官！

scripts.text: What do you mean by chop?
scripts.translation: 砍是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Focus your energy in
your yell when you strike!
Chop! 10 Times! Do it!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
出招时集中你的能量大喊！
砍！10次！做！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Chop...? It's a hand chop.
You strike the enemy with
the bottom of your hand
like a knife blade. How
did you join the army
without knowing that?
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
砍...？那是手刀。
用手掌底部像刀刃一样
击打敌人。你连这个都不知道
是怎么加入军队的？

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Focus your energy in
your yell when you strike!
Chop! 10 Times! Do it!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
出招时集中你的能量大喊！
砍！10次！做！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
The more you train,
the stronger you become.
As you grow stronger, so
does Freya's holy troops.
Train everyday, and don't
you ever slack off!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
训练越多，你就越强。
随着你变强，芙蕾雅的神圣军队
也会变强。每天训练，
绝对不要偷懒！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, sir!

[Colonel Vito]
That is all for your
training. If you have
any questions about camp
life, go ask Sahedi right
outside this building.
You are dismissed.
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
你的训练到此结束。如果有关于
营地生活的问题，去问这栋建筑外面的
萨赫迪。你被解散了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333Well... I think
I will go back to
Sahedi. Hopefully,
he'll think of me as
a geological researcher
instead of as a soldier.^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^333333嗯...我想
我还是回去找
萨赫迪吧。希望
他会把我看作
地质研究员，
而不是士兵。^000000)

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
We must be ever
vigilant in our training.
You can never know when
Freya will call on us to fight!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
我们必须时刻保持警惕。
你永远不知道芙蕾雅
何时会召唤我们战斗！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's a stream of
magma running down
through a path under
the barbed wires.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有一道岩浆流
沿着铁丝网下的
路径流淌。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can hear the faint
sound of hammering, as if
iron was being manufactured
from deep underground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你能听到微弱的锤击声，仿佛是从地下深处锻造铁器一般。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPeople are carrying
many heavy wooden boxes
imprinted with the stamp
of the Schwarzwald Republic.
These must contain military
supplies for the camp.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF人们搬运着许多印有修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国印章的重木箱。
这些里面装的应该是营地的军用物资。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I should go back
to Sahedi now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我现在应该回去找萨赫迪了。

scripts.text:
[Thor Volcano Camp Soldier]
Freya, I'm so exhausted!
I'm starving to death too!
When will we get more rations?
scripts.translation:
[雷神火山营地士兵]
芙蕾雅，我累死了！
我快饿死了！
什么时候能补充口粮啊？

scripts.text:
[Thor Volcano Camp Soldier]
I hear we'll be eating
chicken salad, fried chicken,
and Kunlun style chicken for
dinner tonight! I wonder who
was rich enough to donate
so much chicken to us?
scripts.translation:
[雷神火山营地士兵]
我听说今晚的晚餐是鸡肉沙拉、炸鸡和昆仑风味鸡肉！
真不知道是谁这么大方，给我们捐了这么多鸡肉？

scripts.text:
[Thor Volcano Camp Soldier]
Heheh...
I can't wait for dinner!
scripts.translation:
[雷神火山营地士兵]
嘿嘿...
我迫不及待想开饭了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis control panel
controls the main power
resources for the Thor
Volcano camp, helping it
run its operations smoothly
under the ground.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个控制面板
控制着雷神火山营地的主要能源，
帮助营地在地下的运作顺利进行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
All these pipes with molten
rock flowing through them...
I guess their heat is what
powers this camp. That's
actually a smart idea~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这些管道里流淌着熔岩...
我想就是它们的热量在驱动这个营地。
这其实是个很聪明的想法~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe control panel emits
faint mechanical noises
and seems to be running
pretty smoothly. Everything
looks to be in working order.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF控制面板发出微弱的机械声，
运行得相当平稳。
一切看起来都运转正常。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No problems here.
I guess I can go
back to that colonel.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里没有问题。
我想我可以回去找那位上校了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a training dummy
that looks like it can
take a beating. Its chest
is marked with the emblem
of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这是一个看起来很耐打的训练假人。
它的胸口印着卢恩·米德加兹王国的徽章。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wow...
They really hate the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom...
(^333333Technically, I shouldn't
be doing this. Isn't this
considered treason?^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...
他们真的很讨厌卢恩·米德加兹王国...
(^333333严格来说，我不该做这种事。这算不算叛国？^000000)

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
I can't hear you,
soldier! Make your
voice loud and clear!
Now... Execute attack!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
我听不见，士兵！
大声点！
现在...执行攻击！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, sir!

[{0}]
Three!!

[{0}]
Four!

[{0}]
Seven!!

[{0}]
Eight!!

[{0}]
Nine!

[Colonel Vito]
Soldier...
How many times
did I order you to
chop the dummy?
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
士兵...
我命令你砍木桩
多少次了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
10 times, sir!

[Colonel Vito]
And how many times
did you actually
chop the dummy?
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
那你实际
砍了多少次？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
11 times, sir!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
十一次，长官！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Unacceptable!
Listen to your orders
this time, and do it
again properly!
scripts.translation:
[上校 维托]
不可原谅！
这次给我听清楚命令，
好好再做一次！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better not
do anything too
conspicuous in
front of him.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在他面前
最好别做什么
太显眼的事。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better not
do anything too
conspicuous in
front of him.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在他面前
最好别做什么
太显眼的事。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better not
do anything too
conspicuous in
front of him.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在他面前
最好别做什么
太显眼的事。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better not
do anything too
conspicuous in
front of him.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在他面前
最好别做什么
太显眼的事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Oh Freya...
Bless this Old Blue Box
so that I don't get anything
lame again. I am so tired
of getting arrows from these...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哦，芙蕾雅...
请祝福这个神秘箱子，
让我别再抽到
那些垃圾了。我真的受够了
总是从这些...里抽出箭矢。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Ah, time to
go to work.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
啊，该去
工作了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
What th-?!
Something smells
like sweaty socks that
haven't been washed!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
什-什么？！
什么东西闻起来
像没洗过的臭袜子！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Yo-ho! Yo-ho!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哟呵！哟呵！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I guess I need to go
on Guardian polishing
duty. Those things are
so huge, and I gotta
clean up about twenty...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
看来我得去
执行守卫抛光任务了。
那些东西好大，
我得清理大约二十个...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are many guardians
here in different stages
of disassembly. It looks
like they're all in the
middle of being repaired.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有不同拆解阶段
的守卫。看起来
它们都在维修中。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Aren't you the one from
the geological research
center? There's nothing
for you here, we're just
performing maintenance
on these guardians.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你难道不是
地质研究中心的人吗？
这里没什么给你的，
我们只是在维护
这些守卫。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Why am I always
stationed here?!
No one ever comes
here! Nobody!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
为什么我总是
被派到这里？！
从来没人
来这里！一个都没有！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is an old man
in high priest robes
in front of you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你面前有一位
穿着神官长袍的老人。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better not
do anything too
conspicuous in
front of him.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在他面前
最好别做什么
太显眼的事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guard]
What now?
Can't you see I'm busy?
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
怎么了？
没看到我正忙着吗？

scripts.text: Let me go out.
scripts.translation: 让我出去

scripts.text: I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 对不起。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hurry up, and get out!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
快点，滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
If you're sorry,
stop bugging me!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
如果你感到抱歉，
就别再烦我了！

scripts.text:
[House Owner]
Wh-who the hell
are you? Honey!
There's this...
person in our home!
scripts.translation:
[屋主]
你...你他妈是谁？
亲爱的！
家里进...进人了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFHubbie never came.
Nobody messes with
{0}. Nobody.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF老公从来没回来过。
没人敢招惹{0}。一个都没有。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Welcome to our tavern.
Please, have a seat.
Let me bring you a
glass of ice water first.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
欢迎光临酒馆。
请坐。
我先给您倒杯冰水。

scripts.text:
[Female Customer]
Bartender, aren't any of
your regulars nice young
men? You know, I've been
pretty lonely lately...
scripts.translation:
[女顾客]
调酒师，你的常客里
有没有什么帅哥？
你知道的，我最近
挺寂寞的...

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Haha, well,
I'm not so sure..
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
哈哈，这个嘛，
我不太确定...

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
How about... me?
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
要不...算我一个？

scripts.text:
[Female Customer]
Hmpf...
scripts.translation:
[女顾客]
哼...

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Oh, come on!
I was kidding~
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
哎呀！
我开玩笑的~

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Haha, well,
I'm not so sure..
What about this nice
young adventurer here?
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
哈哈，这个嘛，
我不太确定...
这位帅气的年轻冒险者怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Meee?

[Female Customer]
Mmm...
Not my style.
scripts.translation:
[女顾客]
嗯...
不是我的菜。

scripts.text:
[Male Customer]
How can that ugly old
man have girls hanging
off his arms when I just
got dumped by my girlfriend
and ditched by all my friends?!
scripts.translation:
[男顾客]
那个丑陋的老头怎么能
让女孩们围着他转，
而我刚被女朋友甩了，
还被所有朋友抛弃了？！

scripts.text:
[Male Customer]
Oh, alcohol...
Right now, you're
my only friend in
all the world...
A toast... To drinking!
scripts.translation:
[男顾客]
哦，酒精...
现在，你是
我在这世上
唯一的朋友...
干杯...为了喝酒！
